jobs.description:
Your role
Interested in working in finance, specifically in shaping user experience and making digital banking easy to use and understand, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2026 Off-cycle Internship Program within our Group Technology.

You’ll get to:

• translate content from English and German into French, crafting clear, natural and genuinely human user experiences with support from the team
• help shape a consistent voice, tone and terminology across our digital products, ensuring a seamless experience for users
• develop and manage our multilingual terminology database, collaborating with team members to ensure accurate, up-to-date and consistent terminology across languages
• collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of UX writers, localization professionals, designers, engineers and business stakeholders
• explore and leverage CAT tools, AI tools and new technologies especially to support terminology extraction and validation

Your role will focus primarily on translation (around 50%) and terminology management (around 40%), complemented by work involving language tools, technology, and innovation initiatives.

Your team
Join the software localization team in Zurich and help shape our world-class multilingual user experience on UBS Digital Banking. We are a team of passionate language experts dedicated to making UBS products and services accessible, intuitive and engaging across languages and markets. Through our work, we help users feel confident and supported, ensuring every interaction is as seamless and meaningful as possible, regardless of the language they choose.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree and graduated no longer than six months ago (bachelor's or master's degree), preferably in translation or a related field
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• is a native French speaker with excellent English and German skills; additional language skills, such as Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese or Chinese, are a plus.
• has outstanding localization and editing skills, and can critically evaluate content to ensure it is accurate, engaging, and fit for purpose
• is passionate about delivering high-quality translations and has a strong eye for detail
• is sensitive to the needs of audiences from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds
• has a strong interest in multilingual terminology and terminology database management
• has experience with CAT tools and AI-powered language tools
• is committed to staying up to date with the latest developments in artificial intelligence and best practices in post-editing
• enjoys working in a dynamic environment where they can actively contribute to shaping and improving our processes
• is eager to learn and enjoys working in an international team
• is curious, enjoys asking questions, and brings forward new and innovative ideas
• can quickly grasp new subject areas and concepts
• is open to receiving and implementing feedback
• has programming skills (a plus)

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team.

Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Start date: 1 September 2026 or by agreement

Your program
This paid internship will last 12-months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.
You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers .

Join us
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.
We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Disclaimer / Policy Statements
UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo ruolo
Interessato a lavorare in finanza, specificamente per modellare l'esperienza dell'utente e rendere il digital banking facile da usare e capire, ma non sicuro da dove cominciare? Vuoi lavorare per un'azienda con un'impronta veramente globale?

Stiamo cercando studenti ambiziosi per aderire al nostro 2026 Off-cycle Internship Program all'interno della nostra tecnologia di gruppo.

Si arriva a:

• artigianato chiaro, coinvolgente contenuto UX in tedesco e inglese che consente agli utenti di navigare con fiducia argomenti finanziari complessi
• tradurre contenuti dall'inglese in tedesco con sfumature e creatività, assicurando che ogni interazione sia naturale, autentica e umana
• modellare ed evolvere una voce coerente, tono e terminologia attraverso i nostri prodotti digitali per creare un'esperienza intuitiva e senza soluzione di continuità per gli utenti
• accessibilità del campione creando contenuti inclusivi, compreso il testo alternativo significativo
• collaborare a stretto contatto con un team multidisciplinare di scrittori UX, professionisti della localizzazione, progettisti, ingegneri e stakeholder aziendali
• esplorare e sfruttare gli strumenti AI e le tecnologie emergenti per migliorare la creazione di contenuti, ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro e guidare l'innovazione nel vostro lavoro quotidiano

La tua squadra
Unisciti al team di localizzazione software di Zurigo e aiuta a plasmare la nostra esperienza utente multilingue di livello mondiale su UBS Digital Banking. Siamo un team di esperti di lingue appassionati dedicato a rendere accessibili prodotti e servizi UBS, intuitivi e coinvolgenti in lingue e mercati. Attraverso il nostro lavoro, aiutiamo gli utenti a sentirsi sicuri e supportati, assicurando che ogni interazione sia il più semplice e significativo possibile, indipendentemente dalla lingua che scelgono.

La tua esperienza
Stiamo cercando un candidato che:

• ha completato almeno 4 semestri di un diploma di laurea e si è laureato non più di sei mesi fa (laurea di laurea o master), preferibilmente in traduzione o in un campo correlato
• ha un GPA minimo competitivo di 4.5 secondo il sistema di grading svizzero
• ha valori che si allineano con il nostro: laborioso, affidabile, dedicato e collaborativo
• è un pensatore strategico con forti capacità di comunicazione
• è motivato a lavorare in un business con elevate esigenze e scadenze strette
• può dimostrare come l'uso sperimentale e responsabile di AI può migliorare i risultati e l'efficienza
• è un madrelingua tedesco con eccellenti competenze in inglese; competenze linguistiche aggiuntive, come francese, italiano, spagnolo, portoghese, giapponese o cinese sono un plus
• è appassionato di scrivere contenuti sia in tedesco che in inglese
• ha la conoscenza della scrittura accessibile (a plus)
• è sensibile alle esigenze del pubblico da diversi background culturali e linguistici
• ha esperienza di localizzazione e una forte comprensione di UX/UI
• è appassionato di fornire contenuti e traduzioni di alta qualità e ha un occhio forte per i dettagli
• ha un interesse per la gestione multilingue della terminologia e della terminologia
• in grado di adattare efficacemente i contenuti generati dall'IA in copia coinvolgente su misura per il pubblico di destinazione
• ha esperienza con gli strumenti CAT e gli strumenti di lingua AI-powered
• si impegna a rimanere aggiornati con gli ultimi sviluppi in intelligenza artificiale e le migliori pratiche in post-editing
• gode di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico in cui possono contribuire attivamente a modellare e migliorare i nostri processi
• è ansioso di imparare e gode di lavorare in un team internazionale
• è curioso, ama fare domande, e porta avanti idee nuove e innovative
• può cogliere rapidamente nuove aree e concetti tematici
• è aperto a ricevere e implementare feedback
• ha competenze di programmazione (un plus)

Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è curioso e vuole prosperare in un business che non smette mai di muoversi. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le major, ma è importante avere un interesse per l'industria finanziaria. Vogliamo vedere cosa ti rende unico e scoprire cosa puoi portare alla nostra squadra.

Forse avete organizzato un evento di raccolta fondi o partecipato a sport di squadra? O è uscito dalla tua zona di comfort per conoscere un argomento che hai trovato impegnativo? Fateci sapere come i vostri risultati corrispondono alle competenze che stiamo cercando.

Data di inizio: 1 settembre 2026 o d'accordo

Il tuo programma
Questo tirocinio pagato durerà 12 mesi. Potrai lavorare con i nostri esperti e conoscere il settore, i nostri clienti e la nostra azienda. Sarete al centro della nostra attività, imparando dai vostri colleghi, prendendo parte alle operazioni quotidiane. Ti verranno dati mentori lungo la strada e avrà la possibilità di conoscere alcuni dei membri più anziani delle nostre squadre.
Avrete un sacco di opportunità per sviluppare nuove competenze e fare contatti lungo la strada. Se ti piacciono le sfide, goditi l'apprendimento e vuoi lavorare dove non ci sono due giorni uguali, questo programma è per te.

Se si dispone di uno stage di successo, si può ottenere un'offerta per tornare per il nostro Graduate Talent Program dopo aver completato gli studi.

Informazioni su di noi
UBS è un leader e veramente globale gestore di ricchezza e la principale banca universale in Svizzera. Forniamo anche soluzioni di asset management diversificate e capacità di investment banking focalizzate. Con sede a Zurigo, Svizzera, UBS è presente in oltre 50 mercati in tutto il mondo.
Sappiamo che il grande lavoro non è mai fatto da solo. Ecco perché mettiamo la collaborazione al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché insieme, siamo più di noi stessi. Vuoi saperne di più? Visita ubs.com/careers .

Unisciti a noi
A UBS, sappiamo che è la nostra gente, con le loro diverse competenze, esperienze e sfondi, che guidano il nostro continuo successo. Siamo dedicati al nostro mestiere e appassionati di mettere al primo posto la nostra gente, con nuove sfide, un team di supporto, opportunità di crescere e opzioni di lavoro flessibili quando possibile. La nostra cultura inclusiva fa emergere il meglio dei nostri dipendenti, ovunque si trovino nel loro viaggio di carriera. E usiamo l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) per lavorare più intelligente ed efficiente. Riconosciamo anche che il grande lavoro non è mai fatto da solo. Ecco perché la collaborazione è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché insieme, siamo più di noi stessi.
Ci impegniamo per l’inclusione in disabilità e se avete bisogno di alloggio / adattamenti ragionevoli durante il nostro processo di reclutamento, potete sempre contattarci.

Disclaimer / Informativa
UBS è un dipendente di pari opportunità. Rispettiamo e cerchiamo di potenziare ogni individuo e di sostenere le diverse culture, prospettive, competenze ed esperienze all'interno della nostra forza lavoro.

• is passionate about writing content in both German and English
• has knowledge of accessible writing (a plus)
• is sensitive to the needs of audiences from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds
• has localization experience and a strong understanding of UX/UI
• is passionate about delivering high-quality content and translations and has a strong eye for detail
• has an interest in multilingual terminology and terminology database management
• can effectively adapt AI-generated content into engaging copy tailored to the target audience
• has experience with CAT tools and AI-powered language tools
• is committed to staying up to date with the latest developments in artificial intelligence and best practices in post-editing
• enjoys working in a dynamic environment where they can actively contribute to shaping and improving our processes
• is eager to learn and enjoys working in an international team

• can quickly grasp new subject areas and concepts
• is open to receiving and implementing feedback

You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Deine Rolle
Interessiert an der Arbeit im Finanzwesen, insbesondere an der Gestaltung der Benutzererfahrung und daran, digitales Banking einfach zu bedienen und zu verstehen, aber nicht sicher, wo Sie anfangen sollen? Möchten Sie für ein Unternehmen mit einer wirklich globalen Präsenz arbeiten?

Wir suchen ehrgeizige Studenten, die an unserem Off-Cycle-Praktikumsprogramm 2026 im Rahmen unserer Gruppentechnologie teilnehmen.

Sie erhalten:

• Erstellen Sie klare, ansprechende UX-Inhalte in Deutsch und Englisch, die es Benutzern ermöglichen, komplexe Finanzthemen sicher zu navigieren
• Übersetzung von Inhalten aus dem Englischen ins Deutsche mit Nuancen und Kreativität, um sicherzustellen, dass sich jede Interaktion natürlich, authentisch und menschlich anfühlt
• Formen und entwickeln Sie eine konsistente Stimme, Ton und Terminologie in unseren digitalen Produkten, um ein intuitives, nahtloses Erlebnis für die Benutzer zu schaffen.
• Champion-Zugänglichkeit durch die Erstellung inklusiver Inhalte, einschließlich sinnvoller alternativer Texte
• eng mit einem multidisziplinären Team von UX-Autoren, Lokalisierungsexperten, Designern, Ingenieuren und Geschäftsbeteiligten zusammenarbeiten
• Entdecken und nutzen Sie KI-Tools und neue Technologien, um die Erstellung von Inhalten zu verbessern, Workflows zu optimieren und Innovationen in Ihrer täglichen Arbeit voranzutreiben

Dein Team
Treten Sie dem Software-Lokalisierungsteam in Zürich bei und gestalten Sie unsere erstklassige mehrsprachige Benutzererfahrung im UBS Digital Banking mit. Wir sind ein Team von leidenschaftlichen Sprachexperten, die sich dem Ziel verschrieben haben, UBS-Produkte und -Services für alle Sprachen und Märkte zugänglich, intuitiv und ansprechend zu machen. Durch unsere Arbeit helfen wir den Nutzern, sich sicher und unterstützt zu fühlen, und stellen sicher, dass jede Interaktion so nahtlos und sinnvoll wie möglich ist, unabhängig von der Sprache, die sie wählen.

Ihre Expertise
Wir suchen einen Kandidaten, der:

• mindestens 4 Semester eines Bachelor-Abschlusses abgeschlossen und vor nicht mehr als sechs Monaten abgeschlossen hat (Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss), vorzugsweise in Übersetzung oder einem verwandten Bereich
• hat einen wettbewerbsfähigen Mindest-GPA von 4,5 nach dem Schweizer Einstufungssystem
• hat Werte, die mit unseren übereinstimmen: fleißig, vertrauenswürdig, engagiert und kooperativ
• ist ein strategischer Denker mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• ist motiviert, in einem Unternehmen mit hohen Anforderungen und engen Fristen zu arbeiten
• kann belegen, wie der experimentelle und verantwortungsvolle Einsatz von KI die Ergebnisse und die Effizienz verbessern kann
• ist ein deutscher Muttersprachler mit ausgezeichneten Englischkenntnissen; zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse wie Französisch, Italienisch, Spanisch, Portugiesisch, Japanisch oder Chinesisch sind ein Plus
• leidenschaftlich über das Schreiben von Inhalten auf Deutsch und Englisch
• Wissen über zugängliches Schreiben (a plus)
• ist sensibel für die Bedürfnisse des Publikums aus verschiedenen kulturellen und sprachlichen Hintergründen
• hat Lokalisierungserfahrung und ein starkes Verständnis von UX / UI
• ist begeistert von der Bereitstellung hochwertiger Inhalte und Übersetzungen und hat ein starkes Auge für Details
• hat Interesse an mehrsprachiger Terminologie und Terminologiedatenbankmanagement
• KI-generierte Inhalte effektiv in ansprechende Kopien anpassen können, die auf die Zielgruppe zugeschnitten sind
• hat Erfahrung mit CAT-Tools und KI-gestützten Sprachtools
• ist bestrebt, mit den neuesten Entwicklungen in der künstlichen Intelligenz und Best Practices im Post-Editing auf dem Laufenden zu bleiben
• Sie arbeiten gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sie aktiv dazu beitragen können, unsere Prozesse zu gestalten und zu verbessern.
• ist lernbegierig und arbeitet gerne in einem internationalen Team
• ist neugierig, stellt gerne Fragen und bringt neue und innovative Ideen hervor
• können schnell neue Themenbereiche und Konzepte erfassen
• ist offen für Empfang und Umsetzung von Feedback
• hat Programmierkenntnisse (a plus)

Wir suchen jemanden, der neugierig ist und in einem Geschäft gedeihen möchte, das nie aufhört, sich zu bewegen. Wir begrüßen alle Majors, aber es ist wichtig, ein Interesse an der Finanzindustrie zu haben. Wir wollen sehen, was Sie einzigartig macht und entdecken, was Sie in unser Team bringen können.

Vielleicht haben Sie eine Fundraising-Veranstaltung organisiert oder an Teamsportarten teilgenommen? Oder aus Ihrer Komfortzone herausgetreten, um etwas über ein Thema zu erfahren, das Sie als herausfordernd empfunden haben? Lassen Sie uns wissen, wie Ihre Leistungen mit den Fähigkeiten übereinstimmen, nach denen wir suchen.

Startdatum: 1. September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung

Ihr Programm
Dieses bezahlte Praktikum dauert 12 Monate. Sie arbeiten mit unseren Experten zusammen und lernen die Branche, unsere Kunden und unser Unternehmen kennen. Sie stehen im Mittelpunkt unseres Geschäfts, lernen von Ihren Kollegen und nehmen am Tagesgeschäft teil. Sie erhalten Mentoren auf dem Weg und haben die Möglichkeit, einige der ältesten Mitglieder unserer Teams kennenzulernen.
Sie haben viele Möglichkeiten, neue Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und Kontakte auf dem Weg zu knüpfen. Wenn Sie Herausforderungen mögen, Spaß am Lernen haben und arbeiten möchten, wo keine zwei Tage gleich sind, ist dieses Programm für Sie.

Wenn Sie ein erfolgreiches Praktikum haben, erhalten Sie möglicherweise ein Angebot, nach Abschluss Ihres Studiums für unser Graduate Talent Program zurückzukehren.

Über uns
UBS ist ein weltweit führender Vermögensverwalter und die führende Universalbank der Schweiz. Wir bieten auch diversifizierte Asset-Management-Lösungen und fokussierte Investment-Banking-Funktionen. Mit Hauptsitz in Zürich, Schweiz, ist UBS in mehr als 50 Märkten auf der ganzen Welt präsent.
Wir wissen, dass großartige Arbeit niemals allein geleistet wird. Deshalb stellen wir die Zusammenarbeit in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Denn zusammen sind wir mehr als wir selbst. Möchten Sie mehr erfahren? Besuchen Sie ubs.com/careers.

Begleiten Sie uns
Bei UBS wissen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter mit ihren vielfältigen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Hintergründen unseren anhaltenden Erfolg vorantreiben. Wir widmen uns unserem Handwerk und setzen unsere Mitarbeiter leidenschaftlich an die erste Stelle, mit neuen Herausforderungen, einem unterstützenden Team, Wachstumsmöglichkeiten und flexiblen Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wenn möglich. Unsere integrative Kultur bringt das Beste aus unseren Mitarbeitern heraus, egal wo sie sich auf ihrer Karriere befinden. Und wir nutzen künstliche Intelligenz (KI), um intelligenter und effizienter zu arbeiten. Wir erkennen auch an, dass großartige Arbeit niemals alleine getan wird. Deshalb steht die Zusammenarbeit im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Denn zusammen sind wir mehr als wir selbst.
Wir verpflichten uns zur Inklusion von Behinderungen und wenn Sie während unseres gesamten Rekrutierungsprozesses angemessene Unterkünfte / Anpassungen benötigen, können Sie sich jederzeit an uns wenden.

Disclaimer / Policy Statements
UBS ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir respektieren und bemühen uns, jeden Einzelnen zu stärken und die verschiedenen Kulturen, Perspektiven, Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre rôle
Intéressé à travailler dans la finance, en particulier à façonner l'expérience utilisateur et à rendre la banque numérique facile à utiliser et à comprendre, mais pas sûr par où commencer? Voulez-vous travailler pour une entreprise avec une empreinte véritablement mondiale?

Nous cherchons des étudiants ambitieux pour rejoindre notre programme de stages hors cycle 2026 au sein de notre technologie de groupe.

Vous arriverez à:

• artisanat clair, engagement UX contenu en allemand et en anglais qui permet aux utilisateurs de naviguer en toute confiance des sujets financiers complexes
• traduire le contenu de l'anglais en allemand avec nuance et créativité, en assurant chaque interaction se sent naturel, authentique et humain
• façonner et développer une voix, un ton et une terminologie cohérents dans nos produits numériques pour créer une expérience intuitive et transparente pour les utilisateurs
• promouvoir l'accessibilité en créant un contenu inclusif, y compris un texte alternatif significatif
• collaborer étroitement avec une équipe multidisciplinaire d'écrivains UX, de professionnels de la localisation, de concepteurs, d'ingénieurs et d'intervenants commerciaux
• explorer et exploiter les outils d'IA et les technologies émergentes pour améliorer la création de contenu, rationaliser les flux de travail et stimuler l'innovation dans votre travail quotidien

Votre équipe
Rejoignez l'équipe de localisation des logiciels à Zurich et aidez à façonner notre expérience utilisateur multilingue de classe mondiale sur UBS Digital Banking. Nous sommes une équipe d'experts en langues passionnés dédiée à rendre les produits et services UBS accessibles, intuitifs et engageants dans les langues et les marchés. Grâce à notre travail, nous aidons les utilisateurs à se sentir confiants et soutenus, en veillant à ce que chaque interaction soit aussi transparente et significative que possible, quelle que soit la langue qu'ils choisissent.

Votre expertise
Nous cherchons un candidat qui :

• a terminé au moins 4 semestres d'un baccalauréat et diplômé il n'y a pas plus de six mois (bachelor ou maîtrise), de préférence en traduction ou dans un domaine connexe
• a un GPA minimum compétitif de 4,5 selon le système de classement suisse
• a des valeurs qui s'alignent sur les nôtres : travail acharné, confiance, dévouement et collaboration
• est un penseur stratégique avec de solides compétences en communication
• est motivé à travailler dans une entreprise avec des exigences élevées et des délais serrés
• peut démontrer comment l'utilisation expérimentale et responsable de l'IA peut améliorer les résultats et l'efficacité
• est un locuteur allemand natif avec d'excellentes compétences en anglais; les compétences linguistiques supplémentaires, comme le français, l'italien, l'espagnol, le portugais, le japonais ou le chinois sont un plus
• est passionné par l'écriture de contenu en allemand et en anglais
• possède une connaissance de l'écriture accessible (a plus)
• est sensible aux besoins des publics issus de milieux culturels et linguistiques divers
• a une expérience de localisation et une bonne compréhension de UX/UI
• est passionné par la livraison de contenu et de traductions de haute qualité et a un œil fort pour les détails
• s'intéresse à la gestion multilingue de la terminologie et de la base de données terminologiques
• peut adapter efficacement le contenu généré par l'IA à une copie engageante adaptée au public cible
• a de l'expérience avec les outils CAT et les outils de langage à moteur d'IA
• s'engage à se tenir au courant des derniers développements en matière d'intelligence artificielle et des meilleures pratiques en matière de postédition
• aime travailler dans un environnement dynamique où ils peuvent contribuer activement à façonner et à améliorer nos processus
• est impatient d'apprendre et aime travailler dans une équipe internationale
• est curieux, aime poser des questions, et apporte des idées nouvelles et innovantes
• peut saisir rapidement de nouveaux sujets et concepts
• est ouvert à la réception et à la mise en œuvre des commentaires
• a des compétences en programmation (a plus)

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui est curieux et qui veut prospérer dans une entreprise qui ne cesse jamais de bouger. Nous souhaitons la bienvenue à tous les majors, mais il est important de s'intéresser au secteur financier. Nous voulons voir ce qui vous rend unique et découvrir ce que vous pouvez apporter à notre équipe.

Peut-être avez-vous organisé une activité de financement ou participé à des sports d'équipe? Ou est-il sorti de votre zone de confort pour en apprendre davantage sur un sujet que vous avez trouvé difficile? Faites-nous savoir comment vos réalisations correspondent aux compétences que nous avons après.

Date de début : 1er septembre 2026 ou par accord

Votre programme
Ce stage rémunéré durera 12 mois. Vous allez travailler avec nos experts et apprendre sur l'industrie, nos clients et notre entreprise. Vous serez au cœur de notre entreprise, en apprenant de vos collègues, en participant aux opérations quotidiennes. Vous recevrez des mentors en cours de route et aurez la chance de connaître certains des membres les plus seniors de nos équipes.
Vous aurez de nombreuses occasions de développer de nouvelles compétences et d'établir des contacts le long du chemin. Si vous aimez les défis, profitez de l'apprentissage et voulez travailler où pas deux jours sont les mêmes, ce programme est pour vous.

Si vous avez un stage réussi, vous pouvez obtenir une offre de retour pour notre programme de talents diplômés après avoir terminé vos études.

Sur nous
UBS est un chef de file en matière de gestion de patrimoine mondial et la première banque universelle en Suisse. Nous fournissons également des solutions diversifiées de gestion d'actifs et des capacités de banque d'investissement ciblées. Basé à Zurich, en Suisse, UBS est présent sur plus de 50 marchés à travers le monde.
Nous savons que le grand travail n'est jamais fait seul. C'est pourquoi nous plaçons la collaboration au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Parce qu'ensemble, nous sommes plus que nous. Tu veux en savoir plus ? Visitez ubs.com/careers .

Rejoignez-nous
Chez UBS, nous savons que ce sont nos employés, avec leurs compétences, leurs expériences et leurs antécédents variés, qui sont à l'origine de notre succès continu. Nous sommes dévoués à notre métier et passionnés de mettre notre personnel en premier, avec de nouveaux défis, une équipe de soutien, des opportunités de croissance et des options de travail flexibles si possible. Notre culture inclusive fait ressortir le meilleur de nos employés, où qu'ils soient dans leur parcours de carrière. Et nous utilisons l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour travailler plus intelligemment et plus efficacement. Nous reconnaissons également que le grand travail ne se fait jamais seul. C'est pourquoi la collaboration est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Parce qu'ensemble, nous sommes plus que nous.
Nous nous engageons à l'inclusion des personnes handicapées et si vous avez besoin d'adaptations et d'ajustements raisonnables tout au long de notre processus de recrutement, vous pouvez toujours nous contacter.

Avertissement / Énoncés de politique
UBS est un employeur de l'égalité des chances. Nous respectons et cherchons à responsabiliser chaque individu et à soutenir les diverses cultures, perspectives, compétences et expériences au sein de notre personnel.

Your role
Interested in working in finance, specifically within lending, investing and borrowing, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Internship Program within our Global Financial Intermediaries business in Switzerland.

You’ll get to:
• gain insight and work on projects with multiple stakeholders across the business
• analyze complex situations and present findings in an easy and understandable way
• learn about the different products and services we offer to help our clients execute their investment strategies

Your team
You’ll be working in the Global Financial Intermediaries team. We provide integrated financial solutions to independent financial advisors and multifamily offices in Europe. In this role, you will collaborate with Europe’s top intermediaries and navigate complex client situations, contributing to tailored and innovative solutions for a diverse range of clients.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:
• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than 12 months ago (bachelor's or master's degree)
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• is fluent in German and English

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Start date: February, 2027

Your program
This paid internship will last six months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.
If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers .

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We support the GFIW Business Head in managing their business within risk appetite, maintaining effective governance and risk framework, as well as perform UHNW & GFIW specific controls. Finally, we give expert advice on various risk aspects allowing the business to best serve the bank’s most sophisticated clients.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:
• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than twelve months ago (bachelor's or master's degree), preferably with a focus on business, finance, economics, STEM or similar
• has know-how gained from experience in Business Management, Compliance, Risk or similar
• has sharp analytical and problem solving skills
• has a good command of Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, and is a fast learner when it comes to other IT software/programming language
• has excellent command of English (written and oral), any other language is a plus
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Start Date: January, February 2027

Your program
This paid internship will last 6 months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

• support the preparation of management reporting, dashboards and strategic updates for the Digital Assets leadership team
• perform market research and competitive analysis on digital assets, blockchain, tokenization and related industry trends

Your team

The team supports senior leadership with strategic planning, portfolio oversight, financial management, governance, industry engagement and executive communications across the Digital Assets organization. Your expertise

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than 12 months ago (bachelor's or master's degree)
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• has excellent English skills, German is a plus
• has a passion for digital innovation and client-centric solutions

Your role
Interested in working in finance, and have a passion for technology, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2026 Internship Program within our Group Technology Office.

You’ll get to:

• work on web applications in the Due Diligence space, built with Java/Spring/Oracle
• learn about how our Gitlab pipelines work and identify ways to improve them
• learn about cloud based applications and how they differ from traditional applications
• collaborate with teams across multiple locations, through pair programming and group projects, learning from senior engineers how to build robust, scalable products
• work closely with cross-functional team members to improve our digital products

Your team
You’ll be working in alongside the Group Compliance, Regulatory & Governance (GCRG) Client Reviews team in Zurich or Lausanne. Our team develops, enhances and supports web applications in the Financial Crime Prevention space, with thousands of client advisors and Compliance staff using our systems daily.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than 12 months ago (bachelor's or master's degree)
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Location: Zurich or Lausanne

Start date: 1 February

Your program
This paid internship will last three to six months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

• support Market side Product origination of Private Placements
• act as market maker for illiquid financial instruments and on a large Structured Notes Portfolio
• develop and support automation for a large variety of business owned processes
• work closely with the Quants team to deliver meaningful business solutions for a scalable trading operation

You’ll be working in our Global Markets business. We work with Private Banks, pension funds, asset managers and family offices as well as Issuers in the Banking or Sovereign Agency space to provide coverage, advisory, capital markets and funding services.

• has fully completed their degree and met all graduation requirements by the program start date
• has no more than two years of full-time work experience and is fluent in English
• has prior experience or a strong interest in Capital Markets
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• has a proven track record of working on development and implementation projects, combined with coding skills

• knowledge of Java and object-oriented programming principles
• knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and an interest in modern web technologies
• understanding of software development fundamentals, including testing, source control, and application design
• basic knowledge of databases, SQL, and API-based development
• exposure to development tools such as Git, IntelliJ IDEA, VSCode, Jira, Maven, Gradle, or similar technologies through academic, internship, or personal projects

Your program
Our Graduate Talent Program is 18-months long and is designed to help you develop the skills you need to grow your career. jobs.description:
Your role
Do you want to explore how financial services, public policy, technology and data come together to shape the future of banking? Are you motivated to contribute to advocacy on topics that matter strategically to the bank?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2026 Internship Program within Governmental Affairs.

You’ll get to:

• help monitor and analyze highly relevant political and regulatory developments that have a material impact on UBS's strategy and business, or on our clients, investors, and employees
• contribute to the development of data- and AI-enabled advocacy content and dashboards
• collaborate on advocacy content, position papers, briefings and presentations, translating complex topics into actionable insights
• assist in the development and execution of public affairs and advocacy strategies, including organization and coordination of events, meetings, and stakeholder engagements
• provide general project and administrative support to ongoing advocacy and public affairs activities

Your team
You'll be part of the Governmental Affairs team based in Zurich. Governmental Affairs provides comprehensive coverage of regulatory policy and political processes relevant to UBS, and leads our advocacy efforts, with colleagues based in key regions/jurisdictions globally.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than six months ago (bachelor's or master's degree) ideally in economics or data science
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadline
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• has interest in emerging technologies, data science, and data management; initial experience in public policy or financial market regulation is a plus
• has a strong analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to structure and communicate complex topics clearly
• has excellent German and English skills, fluency in French or Italian area is a plus
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative

Start date: 1 November 2026 or by agreement

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program
This paid internship will last 12 months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.
You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About us
UBS is the world’s largest and only truly global wealth manager. We operate through four business divisions: Global Wealth Management, Personal & Corporate Banking, Asset Management and the Investment Bank. Our global reach and the breadth of our expertise set us apart from our competitors.

With our large and diverse team operating internationally, we have a presence in all major financial centers in more than 50 countries. Although we all come from different backgrounds and specializations, two things unite us: the conviction that we’re stronger together, and the will and curiosity to constantly improve.

Join us
We know that it's our people, with their unique backgrounds, skills, experience levels and interests, who drive our ongoing success. You’ll get to learn from the best at UBS, inspirational leaders from across the business and experts in everything financial industry. Together we’re more than ourselves. Ready to be part of #teamUBS and make an impact?

Disclaimer / Policy Statements
UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

• develop and implement technical solutions
• play an important role in the transformation towards AI-native development journey
• deliver state-of-the-art payment solution and be part of strategic initiatives, including the integration with Distributed Ledger Technology DLT (Blockchain)

Your team
.You’ll be working in the Group Technology Office located in Zurich with focus on payment solutions. We’re responsible for sourcing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting our world-class technology solutions. We’re a global organization with multiple streams that align with each of the key functional areas within UBS to ensure that our solutions meet business needs.
Our global team is mainly responsible for UBS Payment Platform UPP which is used by CH, EMEA and APAC regions.

Based on your interests and experience, you could be placed as a Software Engineering Graduate, DevOps Engineer or Site Reliability Engineering Graduate.

Your expertise
.We’re looking for a candidate who:

• is a recent graduate (graduated in the last 24 months)
• has fully completed their degree and met all graduation requirements by the program start date
• has no more than two years of full-time work experience
has completed their bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in a MINT topic
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has a basic knowledge / experience in JAVA or similar Object-Oriented Programming, understanding of SpringBoot framework is a plus (but not a must)
• has a basic Understanding of NoSQL databases (Mongo, Cosmos) and Containerization (Kubernetes, Docker)
• is striving to learn new technologies and to experiment with AI and to apply this in payment domain.

Start date: 1 February 2027

Your program
Our Graduate Talent Program is 18 months long, and designed to help you develop the skills you need to grow your career. To start, the program introduces you to our firm, provides professional and technical training and teaches you core skills and knowledge of the Group Technology Office. And it continues from there: by learning from your colleagues, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and build your network. You’ll have the opportunity to see beyond your job by participating in one, or several, rotations. If you’re ready to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

jobs.description:
Your role
Do you have a genuine passion for investing or are you just curious about how markets work? Would you rather gain investment experience across asset classes and roles than to immediately specialize? Do you want to explore a genuinely global Asset Manager while still being based in Switzerland?

Are you up for a challenge and a steep learning curve? Then we're looking for you to join our 2027 Asset Management Graduate Talent Program in Investments.

You’ll get to:
• build a strong understanding of our company and industry as well as our culture and strategy
• support teams who provide wholesale, retail and institutional clients with investment products, solutions and advice
• develop in-depth knowledge of financials markets, traditional investments and real estate
• immediate integration in teams with experienced professionals, with practical learning on the job
• up to four rotations in different investment areas, including the potential of cross-divisional rotations
• make life-long connections with graduate peers through networking events, cross-business teach-ins and social occasions

Your team
You will work in UBS Asset Management, one of the leading investment managers in the world. We are a large-scale asset manager offering investment capabilities and styles across all major traditional asset classes and real estate, from active to passive and including a comprehensive sustainable investing offering.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:
• will graduate with a Master’s degree no longer than 18 months prior to starting our program, with less than 12-months of work experience post-graduation
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has experience using LLMs
• is comfortable with numbers, solving problems and logical thinking

jobs.description:
Your role
Curious about how a global bank really works? Join the only function with a truly end-to-end view across UBS. In Group Internal Audit, you'll investigate complex challenges, uncover emerging risks and gain exposure to every corner of the bank. If you love asking questions, connecting dots and solving problems, this is where curiosity becomes impact.

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Internship within our Internal Audit business in Switzerland.

You’ll get to:

• discover how different parts of UBS operate and identify the risks shaping a global financial institution
• investigate how decisions, products and processes work in practice, uncovering insights others might miss
• use data, technology and critical thinking to assess risks, evaluate whether controls are effective
• challenge assumptions to help prevent errors, protect clients and support the firm's strategic goals
• learn from experienced colleagues and gain a unique view while helping UBS stay resilient, safe and prepared for what's next

Your team
You'll be part of Group Internal Audit, the only function with a complete view across UBS. Reporting independently to the Board, we bring together specialists in business, risk, data analytics and AI to identify emerging risks, generate insight and drive change across the firm.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than 12 months ago (bachelor's or master's degree) ideally in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Law, or a related field
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadline
• has a passion for problem-solving and working in a dynamic, international environment
• has an analytical mindset with attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• has excellent English skills, German is a plus
• can explain ideas clearly, whether it’s summarizing findings, asking good questions, or sharing your thoughts in a way others understand
• adapts easily to changing priorities and remains organized when allocated multiple tasks
• acts with integrity, enjoys working with others, and shows curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to learn

Start date: 1 February 2027

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program
This paid internship will last six months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.
You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

Your role
Interested in working in financial services and you are risk aware, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control Graduate Talent Program.
You’ll get to:
• independently review unusual transactions detected by the IT-based AML monitoring system and analyze their economic background
• initiate remedial actions and track their timely resolution
• collaborate with internal stakeholders and competence centers to further and continuously develop the control framework
• learn how GCORC helps protect the firm, enabling responsible business growth, and navigation of an evolving regulatory landscape
• enjoy a personalized learning program including getting to know at least one other team within Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control
• work in a dynamic and proactive environment which is focused on excellence and risk management in a fast-changing world

Your team
The Swiss Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) Monitoring & Surveillance team plays a key role in protecting the bank against money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions and corruption risks. The team reviews unusual transactions, analyzes their economic background and helps identify potential financial crime risks through effective monitoring and surveillance activities.

Group Compliance and Operational Risk Control “GCORC” provides independent oversight, challenge and control over non-financial risks arising from UBS’s business activities. The function helps ensure that compliance, conduct and operational risks are understood, owned and managed within the firm’s risk appetite, while supporting effective remediation and strong control frameworks.

GCORC brings together specialist capabilities across Compliance, Operational Risk Control, Conduct & Investigations and Financial Crime Prevention. These teams work closely with business divisions and group functions to apply consistent standards, strengthen controls and respond to a dynamic regulatory and risk environment.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• is a recent graduate (graduated in the last 24 months)
• has fully completed their degree and met all graduation requirements by the program start date
• has no more than two years of full-time work experience
• has completed their bachelor’s or master’s degree, preferably in Economics, Audit, Finance or Legal
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• is proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and has a strong ability to learn new technology including data visualization and analysis tools
• has excellent German and English skills; French and Italian are beneficial

Start date: 1 February 2027

Your program
Our Graduate Talent Program is 18 months long, and is designed to help you develop the skills you need to grow your career. To start, the program introduces you to our firm, provides professional and technical training and teaches you core skills and knowledge in banking. And it continues from there: by learning from your colleagues, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and build your network. You’ll get to:
• be a part of a large scale transformation program where you will be contributing to business analysis, executive reporting, stakeholder engagement, and program governance activities
• support program planning, conduct business and product analyses, prepare management presentations, and develop insights for decision-making.
• coordinate with stakeholders across business and technology to manage program outcomes and timelines
• assist in planning, risk management, milestone development, and readiness assessments for key program activities
• build an understanding of our industry, culture, and strategy, while learning about how we operate to effectively meet the needs of our clients
• develop professionally by establishing a network of mentors and business contacts we believe are some of the best in the business

Your team
You’ll be working in our Global Wealth Management team in Zurich. We provide advice-based solutions to deliver products and services designed to address the needs of ultra-high net worth and high-net worth individuals and families. We’ve successfully built the number one wealth management franchise in the world. You’ll work with the best talent in the industry, as we help manage, preserve and grow the wealth of our clients.

We are a dynamic team focused on delivering strategic programs and supporting organizational transformation across a complex, global environment. Working at the intersection of business, technology, and change management, we collaborate with diverse stakeholders to drive impactful outcomes and enable sustainable business growth.

Our team combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, providing exposure to senior stakeholders, cross-functional collaboration, and real-world problem solving. Team members are encouraged to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute ideas in a supportive and fast-paced environment.
Joining the team offers a unique opportunity to gain insight into how large organizations execute strategic priorities, manage change, and translate business objectives into measurable results.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than six months ago (bachelor's or master's degree)
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

Start Date: December 2026

Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program
This paid internship will last 6 months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.
You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

Your role
Interested in working in finance, specifically in shaping user experience and making digital banking easy to use and understand, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2026 Off-cycle Internship Program within our Group Technology.

You’ll get to:

• craft clear, engaging UX content in German and English that empowers users to confidently navigate complex financial topics
• translate content from English into German with nuance and creativity, ensuring every interaction feels natural, authentic and human
• shape and evolve a consistent voice, tone and terminology across our digital products to create an intuitive, seamless experience for users
• champion accessibility by creating inclusive content, including meaningful alternative text
• collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of UX writers, localization professionals, designers, engineers and business stakeholders
• explore and leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance content creation, streamline workflows and drive innovation in your everyday work

Your team
Join the software localization team in Zurich and help shape our world-class multilingual user experience on UBS Digital Banking. We are a team of passionate language experts dedicated to making UBS products and services accessible, intuitive and engaging across languages and markets. Through our work, we help users feel confident and supported, ensuring every interaction is as seamless and meaningful as possible, regardless of the language they choose.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:

• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree and graduated no longer than six months ago (bachelor's or master's degree), preferably in translation or a related field
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• is a native German speaker with excellent English skills; additional language skills, such as French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese or Chinese are a plus
• is passionate about writing content in both German and English
• has knowledge of accessible writing (a plus)
• is sensitive to the needs of audiences from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds
• has localization experience and a strong understanding of UX/UI
• is passionate about delivering high-quality content and translations and has a strong eye for detail
• has an interest in multilingual terminology and terminology database management
• can effectively adapt AI-generated content into engaging copy tailored to the target audience
• has experience with CAT tools and AI-powered language tools
• is committed to staying up to date with the latest developments in artificial intelligence and best practices in post-editing
• enjoys working in a dynamic environment where they can actively contribute to shaping and improving our processes
• is eager to learn and enjoys working in an international team
• is curious, enjoys asking questions, and brings forward new and innovative ideas
• can quickly grasp new subject areas and concepts
• is open to receiving and implementing feedback
• has programming skills (a plus)

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team.

Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Start date: 1 February 2027
Length: 6 months

Your program
This paid internship will last six months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.
You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

• Entwicklung und Verwaltung unserer mehrsprachigen Terminologiedatenbank in Zusammenarbeit mit Teammitgliedern, um eine genaue, aktuelle und konsistente Terminologie in allen Sprachen zu gewährleisten
• eng mit einem multidisziplinären Team von UX-Autoren, Lokalisierungsexperten, Designern, Ingenieuren und Geschäftsbeteiligten zusammenarbeiten
• Erkundung und Nutzung von CAT-Tools, KI-Tools und neuen Technologien, insbesondere zur Unterstützung der Terminologieextraktion und -validierung

Ihre Rolle wird sich hauptsächlich auf Übersetzung (rund 50%) und Terminologiemanagement (rund 40%) konzentrieren, ergänzt durch Arbeiten mit Sprachtools, Technologie und Innovationsinitiativen.

jobs.description:
Your role
Interested in working in finance, specifically as a wealth management professional serving clients, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint that consistently ranks among the world's top financial institutions?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Internship Program within our Global Wealth Management business.

You’ll get to:
• opportunity to further develop the UBS risk management solutions for investment products that are used in the context of client advisory and investment suitability.
• responsibility for maintaining and enhancing the product and portfolio risk models in close collaboration with investment products and risk experts.
• combine your analytical, financial, technical skills to contribute to a variety of projects
• proactively prepare analytics, special reports and presentations for different stakeholders.
• collaborate with different teams on strategic projects with a goal of improving our client experience and driving engagement
• build an understanding of our industry, culture, and strategy, while learning about how we operate to effectively meet the needs of our clients
• develop professionally by establishing a network of mentors and business contacts we believe are some of the best in the business
• attend educational events led by senior leaders that provide extensive exposure and insight into the business

Your team
You’ll become part of Global Wealth Management. We provide advice-based solutions to deliver products and services designed to address the needs of ultra-high net worth and high-net worth individuals and families. We’ve successfully built the number one wealth management franchise in the world. You’ll work with the best talent in the industry, as we help manage, preserve and grow the wealth of our clients.

More specifically, you will be working in our Investment Suitability Methodology team in Zurich, the investment risk competence center within Global Wealth Management. We are responsible for models and methodologies which are a crucial success factor across the stages of the GWM investment process. Our work and outputs support all GWM client advisors for portfolio construction and for providing suitable investment advice.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:
• has completed at least 4 semesters of a bachelor's degree, and graduated no longer than six months ago (bachelor's or master's degree)
• has degree in a quantitative or finance area (statistics, quantitative finance, mathematics, financial engineering, etc.)
• has knowledge of statistical and econometric methods and their application
• has understanding of Python or R, Gitlab version control and SQL
• has strong interest in financial markets and risk management
• has excellent English (written and oral), fluency in Germany is a plus
• potential post-graduate degree like CFA or FRM as a plus
• has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
• is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
• is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

Start Date: February 2027

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program
This paid internship will last 6 months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.
If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers .

Join us
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.
We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Disclaimer / Policy Statements
UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Corporate and Institutional Clients (CIC) Graduate Talent Program in Switzerland.

You’ll get to:
• act as an important contact for our demanding large multinational clients and provide advice and support on operational matters in close collaboration with account managers and client advisors
• take ownership of a broad range of client-related activities in the day-to-day business (e.g., administrative tasks including management of pending items, payments / cash management, fixed advances, FX spot transactions, money market deposits)
• handle front-to-back onboarding of new clients and expanding existing relationships (documentation of relationship openings, e-banking / connectivity, cash management, etc.)
• ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., Know Your Customer, periodic client reviews)
• coordinate with internal stakeholders such as Operations, Compliance, Risk Management, and product specialists
• develop a comprehensive understanding of corporate banking and build valuable stakeholder management, and client servicing skills

Your team
You’ll be working in our Multinationals team, located at Europaallee in Zurich. Multinationals is part of Corporate & Institutional Clients and develops first-class, individual solutions for around 400, mostly listed Swiss corporations. As a GTP within Account Management, you will play an important role in supporting large multinational clients in close collaboration with account managers, client advisors and various specialists.

You will have the opportunity to develop a broad range of skills and actively apply them in your daily work with large corporate clients. You will be part of a dynamic and diverse team that cultivates an open feedback culture and a mutually supportive cooperation.

Take the opportunity to enter a promising area of the bank and thereby seize a great development opportunity for your professional future.

Your expertise
We’re looking for a candidate who:
• is a recent graduate (graduated in the last 24 months)
• has a competitive minimum GPA of 4.5 according to the Swiss grading system
• can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency
• is fluent in German and very good in English, both written and spoken
• enjoys interacting with demanding clients and stakeholders and ideally has gained initial experience in client-facing roles or banking
• demonstrates a strong client and service orientation, a high level of commitment and enjoys taking responsibility for operational tasks
• thrives in a business with high expectations, competing priorities and tight deadlines
• has values that align with ours: being trustworthy, dedicated, collaborative and committed to achieving excellent outcomes for our clients

Your program
Our Graduate Talent Program is 18 months long, and is designed to help you develop the skills you need to grow your career.
