UBS è un datore di lavoro che promuove pari opportunità. Rispettiamo tutti i dipendenti come individui così come diverse culture, prospettive, competenze ed esperienze del nostro personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Key responsibilities
Are you looking for a flexible part-time job in permanent employment at UBS with a degree of employment of 40% to 60% and thus a first entry into the financial world?
Digital technologies – not a foreign word for you?
You are a communicative personality who convinces on the phone and in video consulting. With your sensitive and open-minded nature, you quickly recognize the signals in the customer conversation. Your talent is in demand! For our location in Zurich we are looking for reinforcement.

You will
• You can deepen your interest in provision, investments, and financing and use it profitably.
• optimally apply your knowledge in pension planning and pension planning as well as in the mortgage sector.
• On behalf of UBS, you contact our customers as part of bank- and product-specific campaigns.
• Apply your sales skills on the phone and support our specialists by making appointments
• over time in your professional development closely accompanied by the management team.

In "Remote Sales & Advice - Outbound" you lay the foundation for your career in the financial industry. The ideal opportunity to develop personally and professionally in a dynamic team. You get the opportunity to expand your banking knowledge and further develop your communication skills.

The team
You work in the outbound team of the Digital Remote Sales unit in Zurich. We are a young, motivated team with many part-time employees in particular. Students.
Surrounded by a young and dynamic team, you will contact our existing and new bank customers. Thanks to our “Remote Sales & Advice” unit, they benefit from professional and location-independent advice by telephone or in video consulting.
Diversity helps us grow together. That is why we are committed to promoting and nurturing diversity, equal opportunities and inclusion. This strengthens our business and adds value to our customers.

Your skills and experience
• A completed basic education with a deepening in the area of Banking & Finance (e.g. commercial apprenticeship Bank, Matura with a focus on Economics/Finance, studies or further education in the financial sector)
• Strong interest in banking topics as well as passion for sales and the talent to inspire and convince people
• Safe and competent appearance on the phone, with which you address customers professionally and effectively
• Routine in the efficient use of IT applications and digital technologies, especially in the banking environment
• Knowledge of our financial products, such as bank packages, credit cards and digital products
• Advantage: Experience in the distribution of investment and pension solutions and, if necessary, mortgage financing
• Very good knowledge of German and a good understanding of spoken Swiss dialects; further language skills (English, French, Italian) are beneficial

About us
UBS is a leading global asset manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also offer diversified solutions in asset management and focused skills in investment banking. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets worldwide.
We know that great work is never done alone. That is why we put cooperation at the heart of everything we do. Together we are more than just ourselves. Want to know more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

How we hire
We may ask you to conduct one or more placement tests during the application process. Find out more about it (EN)

Join us
At UBS, we know that our employees, with their different skills, experiences and backgrounds, make our success. We are passionate about putting our employees first by offering them new challenges, a supportive team, development opportunities and, where possible, flexible working conditions. Our inclusive culture brings the best out of our employees, no matter where they are on their career path. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also know that great work is never done alone. That is why cooperation is at the heart of our action. Together we are stronger.
We are committed to the inclusion of people with disabilities and strive to make our application process accessible to all. If you need support during our recruitment process, you can therefore contact us at any time.

UBS Recruitment

jobs.description:
Key responsibilities
Are you a dynamic relationship manager who delivers an exceptional client experience? Do you have a strong track record in client advisory and sales? Are you well connected to Chinese entrepreneurs and High Net Worth Individuals and Families? Are you a proven risk manager?

We’re looking for a Wealth Management client advisor, in Zurich, Switzerland, covering the China market. Your key responsibilities are:

• build, establish and grow client relationships
• provide trusted advice to clients in collaboration with colleagues in investment products and solutions teams
• develop the client book with measurable outcomes
• keep accurate and up-to-date records on client investor profiles
• take a strategic view of clients’ investments and closely monitor their portfolio quality
• comply with all regulations, policies and standards to be in line with our risk management culture

Your Career Comeback
We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback .

The team
You’ll be working in a well-established High Net Worth (HNW) team covering China, in Zurich, with multi decades of track record. We’re focused on managing, preserving and growing our clients’ wealth, and help our clients plan for and manage succession. We provide our employees with training and continuous education to better serve our clients and promote personal development. As a client advisor, you’ll play an important role in helping us stay a global leader in wealth management.

Your skills and experience
• proven experience in relationship management, asset gathering and investments, ideally 5 years+ working in a client-facing role in China market
• extensive network to Chinese entrepreneurs and High Net Worth individuals and families
• firm grasp of financial markets and regulatory frameworks in China
• ability to build strong client networks, with an entrepreneurial mind-set
• resilient team player to cope with pressure
• aptitude for digitization and technology
• excellent communicator in Mandarin to support local client base
• You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use

About us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers .

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabilità chiave
Sei un appassionato responsabile delle relazioni che offre un'esperienza cliente eccezionale? Hai un forte record di consulenza e vendita dei clienti? Sei ben collegato con gli imprenditori asiatici e Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNWI)? Sei un responsabile del rischio?

Stiamo cercando un consulente clienti Wealth Management, a Zurigo, in Svizzera, per la regione asiatica. Idealmente con focus sul mercato di Singapore. Le tue responsabilità chiave sono:

• costruire, stabilire e far crescere i rapporti con i clienti all'interno del segmento UHNWI
• fornire consigli affidabili ai clienti in collaborazione con i colleghi nei team di prodotti e soluzioni di investimento
• avere un piano per sviluppare il libro client con risultati misurabili
• mantenere record accurati e aggiornati sui profili degli investitori client
• prendere una visione strategica degli investimenti dei clienti e monitorare attentamente la qualità del portafoglio
• rispettare tutte le normative, le politiche e gli standard per essere in linea con la nostra cultura di gestione dei rischi

Il tuo ritorno di carriera
Siamo aperti alle applicazioni da parte dei ritorni di carriera. Maggiori informazioni sul nostro programma su ubs.com/careercomeback .

La squadra
Potrai lavorare in un consolidato team di Ultra High Net e High Net per i paesi asiatici, a Zurigo, con più decenni di record. Siamo concentrati sulla gestione, la conservazione e la crescita della ricchezza dei nostri clienti, e aiutare i nostri clienti a pianificare e gestire la successione. Forniamo ai nostri dipendenti formazione e formazione continua per servire meglio i nostri clienti e promuovere lo sviluppo personale. In qualità di consulente del cliente, si svolgerà un ruolo importante nell'aiutare a rimanere un leader globale nella gestione della ricchezza.

Lavoriamo in un team multiculturale asiatico con lingue di lavoro inglese, cantonese, giapponese o mandarino.

Anche se siamo diversi in termini di nazionalità, genere, gruppi di età e background professionali siamo uniti dalla nostra passione per il business e il successo.

Le tue abilità ed esperienza
• comprovato talento di acquisizione e appassionato networker nel campo UHNWI
• vasta rete per gli imprenditori e High Net Worth individui in Asia. Idealmente nel mercato di Singapore.
• esperienza nella gestione delle relazioni, raccolta e investimenti, idealmente 10+ anni che lavorano in un ruolo di cliente
• stretta comprensione dei mercati finanziari e dei quadri normativi
• capacità di costruire forti reti client, con una mentalità imprenditoriale
• giocatore di squadra resiliente e veramente orientato al servizio
• aptitude per la digitalizzazione e la tecnologia
• eccellente comunicatore in inglese e lingue asiatiche locali (cantonese, giapponese o mandarino) per sostenere la base clienti locale
• Sei curioso di esplorare come l'IA può migliorare come costruiamo, forniamo e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro. Lo fai con un giudizio sano – convalidare gli output e allineare con politiche, standard di rischio e uso etico.

Stiamo cercando il suo dossier.

Su di noi
UBS è un leader e veramente globale gestore di ricchezza e la principale banca universale in Svizzera. Forniamo anche soluzioni di asset management diversificate e capacità di investment banking focalizzate. Con sede a Zurigo, Svizzera, UBS è presente in oltre 50 mercati in tutto il mondo.
Sappiamo che il grande lavoro non è mai fatto da solo. Ecco perché mettiamo la collaborazione al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché insieme, siamo più di noi stessi. Vuoi saperne di più? Visitate ubs.com/careers .

Iscriviti a noi
A UBS, sappiamo che è la nostra gente, con le loro diverse competenze, esperienze e sfondi, che guidano il nostro continuo successo. Siamo dedicati al nostro mestiere e appassionati di mettere al primo posto la nostra gente, con nuove sfide, un team di supporto, opportunità di crescere e opzioni di lavoro flessibili quando possibile. La nostra cultura inclusiva fa emergere il meglio dei nostri dipendenti, ovunque si trovino nel loro viaggio di carriera. E usiamo l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) per lavorare più intelligente ed efficiente. Riconosciamo anche che il grande lavoro non è mai fatto da solo. Ecco perché la collaborazione è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché insieme, siamo più di noi stessi.
Ci impegniamo per l'inclusione in disabilità e se avete bisogno di un alloggio ragionevole / adattamenti durante il nostro processo di reclutamento, potete sempre contattarci.

Dettagli di contatto

Hauptzuständigkeiten
Sind Sie ein leidenschaftlicher Relationship Manager, der eine außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrung bietet? Haben Sie eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in der Kundenberatung und im Vertrieb? Sind Sie gut mit asiatischen Unternehmern und Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNWI) verbunden? Sind Sie ein bewährter Risikomanager?

Wir suchen einen Wealth Management Kundenberater in Zürich, Schweiz, der die Region Asien abdeckt. Idealerweise mit Fokus auf den Markt in Singapur. Ihre Hauptaufgaben sind:

• Aufbau, Aufbau und Ausbau Ihrer Kundenbeziehungen innerhalb des UHNWI-Segments
• Vertrauensvolle Beratung für Kunden in Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen in Anlageprodukten und Lösungsteams
• einen Plan haben, um das Kundenbuch mit messbaren Ergebnissen zu entwickeln
• Führen Sie genaue und aktuelle Aufzeichnungen über Kundeninvestorprofile
• einen strategischen Blick auf die Investitionen der Kunden zu nehmen und ihre Portfolioqualität genau zu überwachen
• alle Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Standards einhalten, um unserer Risikomanagementkultur zu entsprechen

Dein Karriere-Comeback
Wir sind offen für Bewerbungen von Career Returnern. Erfahren Sie mehr über unser Programm auf ubs.com/careercomeback.

Das Team
Sie arbeiten in einem etablierten Ultra High Net Worth und High Net Worth Team, das asiatische Länder in Zürich abdeckt, mit jahrzehntelanger Erfolgsbilanz. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Verwaltung, Erhaltung und das Wachstum des Vermögens unserer Kunden und unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Planung und Verwaltung der Nachfolge. Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern Schulungen und kontinuierliche Schulungen, um unseren Kunden besser zu dienen und die persönliche Entwicklung zu fördern. Als Kundenberater spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle dabei, uns dabei zu helfen, ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Wealth Management zu bleiben.

Wir arbeiten in einem multikulturellen asiatischen Team mit Arbeitssprachen Englisch, Kantonesisch, Japanisch oder Mandarin.

Obwohl wir in Bezug auf Nationalitäten, Geschlechter, Altersgruppen und berufliche Hintergründe vielfältig sind, verbindet uns unsere Leidenschaft für Wirtschaft und Erfolg.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• ausgewiesenes Akquisitionstalent und leidenschaftlicher Netzwerker im UHNWI-Bereich
• Umfangreiches Netzwerk zu Unternehmern und High Net Worth Einzelpersonen in Asien. Idealerweise auf dem Markt von Singapur.
• Erfahrung in Beziehungsmanagement, Vermögenserfassung und Investitionen, idealerweise 10+ Jahre in einer Kundenrolle
• festes Verständnis von Finanzmärkten und regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen
• Fähigkeit, starke Kundennetzwerke aufzubauen, mit einer unternehmerischen Denkweise
• widerstandsfähiger Teamplayer und wirklich serviceorientiert
• Eignung für Digitalisierung und Technologie
• Ausgezeichneter Kommunikator in Englisch und lokalen asiatischen Sprachen (Kantonesisch, Japanisch oder Mandarin), um den lokalen Kundenstamm zu unterstützen
• Sie möchten herausfinden, wie KI die Art und Weise, wie wir Workflows erstellen, bereitstellen und optimieren, verbessern kann. Sie tun dies mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen - Validierung von Ergebnissen und Abstimmung mit Richtlinien, Risikostandards und ethischer Nutzung.

Wir suchen Ihr Bewerbungsdossier.

Über uns
UBS ist ein weltweit führender Vermögensverwalter und die führende Universalbank der Schweiz. Wir bieten auch diversifizierte Asset-Management-Lösungen und fokussierte Investment-Banking-Funktionen. Mit Hauptsitz in Zürich, Schweiz, ist UBS in mehr als 50 Märkten auf der ganzen Welt präsent.
Wir wissen, dass großartige Arbeit niemals allein geleistet wird. Deshalb stellen wir die Zusammenarbeit in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Denn zusammen sind wir mehr als wir selbst. Möchten Sie mehr erfahren? Besuchen Sie ubs.com/careers.

Begleiten Sie uns
Bei UBS wissen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter mit ihren vielfältigen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Hintergründen unseren anhaltenden Erfolg vorantreiben. Wir widmen uns unserem Handwerk und setzen unsere Mitarbeiter leidenschaftlich an die erste Stelle, mit neuen Herausforderungen, einem unterstützenden Team, Wachstumsmöglichkeiten und flexiblen Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wenn möglich. Unsere integrative Kultur bringt das Beste aus unseren Mitarbeitern heraus, egal wo sie sich auf ihrer Karriere befinden. Und wir nutzen künstliche Intelligenz (KI), um intelligenter und effizienter zu arbeiten. Wir erkennen auch an, dass großartige Arbeit niemals alleine getan wird. Deshalb steht die Zusammenarbeit im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Denn zusammen sind wir mehr als wir selbst.

Principales responsabilités
Êtes-vous un gestionnaire de relations passionné qui offre une expérience client exceptionnelle? Avez-vous une solide expérience en matière de conseils aux clients et de ventes? Êtes-vous bien connecté aux entrepreneurs asiatiques et Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNWI) ? Êtes-vous un gestionnaire de risque éprouvé ?

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un conseiller client Gestion de patrimoine, à Zurich, en Suisse, couvrant la région asiatique. Idéalement en mettant l'accent sur le marché singapourien. Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :

• construire, établir et développer vos relations client au sein du segment UHNWI
• fournir des conseils de confiance aux clients en collaboration avec des collègues des équipes de produits et de solutions d'investissement
• avoir un plan pour développer le livre client avec des résultats mesurables
• tenir des dossiers exacts et à jour sur les profils des investisseurs clients
• prendre une vision stratégique des investissements des clients et suivre de près la qualité de leur portefeuille
• se conformer à tous les règlements, politiques et normes conformes à notre culture de gestion des risques

Votre retour professionnel
Nous sommes ouverts aux demandes de retour de carrière. En savoir plus sur notre programme sur ubs.com/careercomeback .

L'équipe
Vous travaillerez dans une équipe d'Ultra High Net et High Net bien établie couvrant les pays asiatiques, à Zurich, avec plusieurs décennies de succès. Nous nous concentrons sur la gestion, la préservation et la croissance de la richesse de nos clients, et aidons nos clients à planifier et gérer la relève. Nous offrons à nos employés une formation et une éducation continue pour mieux servir nos clients et promouvoir le développement personnel. En tant que conseiller client, vous jouerez un rôle important en nous aidant à rester un leader mondial en gestion de patrimoine.

Nous travaillons dans une équipe multiculturelle asiatique avec des langues de travail anglaise, cantonaise, japonaise ou mandarine.

Bien que nous soyons différents en termes de nationalités, de sexe, de groupes d'âge et d'origines professionnelles, nous sommes unis par notre passion pour les affaires et le succès.

Vos compétences et votre expérience
• un talent d'acquisition éprouvé et un réseau passionné au sein du champ UHNWI
• vaste réseau pour les entrepreneurs et les personnes de haute valeur nette en Asie. Idéalement sur le marché singapourien.
• expérience dans la gestion des relations, la collecte d'actifs et les investissements, idéalement 10+ ans travaillant dans un rôle de client
• une bonne compréhension des marchés financiers et des cadres réglementaires
• capacité à construire des réseaux de clients solides, avec un état d'esprit entrepreneurial
• joueur d'équipe résilient et vraiment orienté service
• aptitude à la numérisation et à la technologie
• excellent communicateur en anglais et en langues asiatiques locales (cantonais, japonais ou mandarin) pour soutenir la clientèle locale
• Vous êtes curieux d'explorer comment l'IA peut améliorer la façon dont nous construisons, livrons et optimisons les flux de travail. Vous faites cela avec un bon jugement – valider les extrants et aligner avec les politiques, les normes de risque et l'utilisation éthique.

Nous cherchons votre dossier de candidature.

À propos de nous
UBS est un chef de file en matière de gestion de patrimoine mondial et la première banque universelle en Suisse. Nous fournissons également des solutions diversifiées de gestion d'actifs et des capacités de banque d'investissement ciblées. Basé à Zurich, UBS est présent sur plus de 50 marchés à travers le monde.
Nous savons que le grand travail n'est jamais fait seul. C'est pourquoi nous plaçons la collaboration au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Parce qu'ensemble, nous sommes plus que nous. Tu veux en savoir plus ? Visitez ubs.com/careers .

Rejoignez-nous
Chez UBS, nous savons que ce sont nos employés, avec leurs compétences, leurs expériences et leurs antécédents variés, qui sont à l'origine de notre succès continu. Nous sommes dévoués à notre métier et passionnés de mettre nos gens en premier, avec de nouveaux défis, une équipe de soutien, des opportunités de croissance et des options de travail flexibles lorsque possible. Notre culture inclusive fait ressortir le meilleur de nos employés, où qu'ils soient sur leur parcours de carrière. Et nous utilisons l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour travailler plus intelligemment et plus efficacement. Nous reconnaissons également que le grand travail ne se fait jamais seul. C'est pourquoi la collaboration est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Parce qu'ensemble, nous sommes plus que nous.
Nous nous engageons à l'inclusion des personnes handicapées et si vous avez besoin d'adaptations et d'ajustements raisonnables tout au long de notre processus de recrutement, vous pouvez toujours nous contacter.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Key responsibilities
Are you a passionate relationship manager who delivers an exceptional client experience? Do you have a strong track record in client advisory and sales? Are you well connected to Asian entrepreneurs and Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNWI)? Are you a proven risk manager?

We’re looking for a Wealth Management client advisor, in Zurich, Switzerland, covering the North Asian Region. Your key responsibilities are:

• build, establish and grow your client relationships
• provide trusted advice to clients in collaboration with colleagues in investment products and solutions teams
• have a plan to develop the client book with measurable outcomes
• keep accurate and up-to-date records on client investor profiles
• take a strategic view of clients’ investments and closely monitor their portfolio quality
• comply with all regulations, policies and standards to be in line with our risk management culture

Your Career Comeback
We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback .

The team
You’ll be working in a well-established Ultra High Net worth and High Net worth team covering North Asian countries, in Zurich, with multi decades of track record. We’re focused on managing, preserving and growing our clients’ wealth, and help our clients plan for and manage succession. We provide our employees with training and continuous education to better serve our clients and promote personal development. As a client advisor, you’ll play an important role in helping us stay a global leader in wealth management.

Although we are diverse in terms of nationalities, genders, age groups and professional backgrounds we are united by our passion for business and success.

Your skills and experience
• proven acquisition talent and passionate networker within the UHNWI field
• extensive network to entrepreneurs and High Net Worth individuals in Asia.
• experience in relationship management, asset gathering and investments, ideally 7+ years working in a client-facing role
• firm grasp of financial markets and regulatory frameworks
• ability to build strong client networks, with an entrepreneurial mind-set
• resilient team player and truly service oriented
• aptitude for digitization and technology
• excellent communicator in English and local Asian languages (Cantonese, Japanese, Mandarin) to support local client base
• You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use

We are looking for your application dossier.

About us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers .

Join us
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. jobs.description:
Key responsibilities
As a Senior Conversation Designer in the Experience Design Center of Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of human-computer interaction at UBS. You will be responsible for designing and optimizing conversational experiences across a range of interfaces, including chatbots, voice assistants, and emerging AI-driven platforms. Your work will directly influence how users engage with our products and services—ensuring interactions are seamless, intuitive, and human-centered.
Beyond delivery, you will contribute to advancing conversational banking at UBS by driving thought leadership, shaping standards, and educating stakeholders on best practices in conversation design and AI-powered interactions.

As conversational experiences increasingly incorporate generative AI and agentic capabilities, the role also involves exploring how prompts, intents, tools, and system behaviors can be designed to support reliable, helpful, and context-aware user interactions. The ideal candidate does not need to be a technical expert in LLMs or agentic systems, but should be curious, pragmatic, and able to apply strong common sense when shaping AI-powered experiences.

Your responsibilities:

• design and optimize end-to-end conversational journeys, from discovery to continuous improvement, across text and voice-based interfaces
• develop and refine conversational flows and scripts, including error handling, fallback strategies, and human handover paths, to ensure they are intuitive, engaging, and effective
• conduct user research and gather feedback to understand user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use these insights to outline our users mental model when engaging with the bank through a conversational interface
• work closely with product managers, UX designers, developers, and other stakeholders to align conversation designs with overall product goals and user experience strategies
• write clear, concise, and natural-sounding dialog for chat and voice, ensuring consistency with brand tone and conversation design best practices
• maintain clean, modular, and scalable conversation design documentation for our products
• create, document, and evaluate system-level guidance for AI personas and interaction models
• define and structure user intents, goals, and conversation outcomes to support both deterministic and AI-assisted conversational experiences
• design and refine prompts and interaction patterns for LLM-based systems, ensuring safe, accurate, and on-brand outputs
• analyze user interactions and conversation logs, including KPIs such as intent success, resolution rate, and user satisfaction, to identify areas for improvement and optimize conversational flows
• ensure conversational experiences comply with regulatory, legal, and data privacy requirements in a banking environment
• keep up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in conversational AI, LLMs, and user experience to inform conversation design
• lead and grow a community around conversation design within the global organization
• act as a thought leader by advancing conversational banking practices, educating stakeholders, and establishing conversation design standards across the organization

Your Career Comeback
We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback .

The team
Marketing, Design & Digital Sales are constantly looking for new talents to shape the future of UBS. You will be working in the Center of Excellence (CoE) for Experience Design, based in Zurich. In our agile organization, you will be collaborating with design, product, channel, marketing, legal, and client need teams and support the organizational transformation toward a client centric design organization and shape client experiences while working agile in a hybrid working model at UBS offices and from home.

Your skills and experience
• proven experience in designing conversational interfaces for chatbots, voice assistants, interactive voice responses (IVRs), and related work
• strong understanding of conversation/interaction principles and linguistics (e.g., turn-taking, sequence organization, repair)
• strong understanding of natural language processing (NLP), natural language understanding (NLU) design and its evolution with LLMs and agentic frameworks
• understanding of intents, entities, conversation goals, and how they support effective chatbot and virtual assistant design
• comfortable working in ambiguous and evolving AI design spaces, where best practices are still emerging
• ability to create engaging and natural conversational experiences that delight users
• strong analytical skills to interpret data and make informed design decisions
• excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate design concepts and rationale clearly
• familiarity with LLMs and their practical applications in conversation design
• proficiency in Figma and other advanced design tools
• proficiency in English is required; proficiency in two or more national languages (German, French, Italian) is a strong advantage
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Linguistics, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree

About us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Responsabilità chiave
Come Senior Conversation Designer nel centro di eccellenza del design dell'esperienza, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione del futuro dell'interazione uomo-computer a UBS. Sarete responsabili per la progettazione e l'ottimizzazione di esperienze di conversazione in una gamma di interfacce, tra cui chatbot, assistenti vocali e piattaforme AI-driven emergenti. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà direttamente il modo in cui gli utenti si impegnano con i nostri prodotti e servizi, garantendo interazioni senza soluzione di continuità, intuitiva e concentrata sull'uomo.
Oltre alla consegna, contribuirai ad avanzare nel settore bancario conversazionale presso UBS guidando la leadership del pensiero, plasmando gli standard, e istruendo gli stakeholder sulle migliori pratiche nella progettazione delle conversazioni e nelle interazioni potenziate dall'IA.

Poiché le esperienze di conversazione incorporano sempre più capacità generative AI e agentic, il ruolo consiste anche nell'esplorazione di come sollecitazioni, intenti, strumenti e comportamenti di sistema possono essere progettati per supportare interazioni utente affidabili, utili e contestuali. Il candidato ideale non ha bisogno di essere un esperto tecnico in LLM o sistemi agentici, ma dovrebbe essere curioso, pragmatico, e in grado di applicare un forte senso comune quando si modellano esperienze alimentate da AI.

Le tue responsabilità:

• progettazione e ottimizzazione dei viaggi di conversazione end-to-end, dalla scoperta al miglioramento continuo, attraverso interfacce basate su testo e voce
• sviluppare e perfezionare i flussi e gli script di conversazione, tra cui la gestione degli errori, le strategie di fallback e i percorsi di handover umani, per garantire che siano intuitivi, coinvolgenti ed efficaci
• condurre la ricerca degli utenti e raccogliere feedback per comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, le preferenze e i punti di dolore. Utilizzare queste intuizioni per delineare il nostro modello mentale degli utenti quando si impegna con la banca attraverso un'interfaccia di conversazione
• lavorare a stretto contatto con i product manager, i progettisti UX, gli sviluppatori e altri stakeholder per allineare i progetti di conversazione con gli obiettivi globali del prodotto e le strategie di esperienza degli utenti
• scrivere dialogo chiaro, conciso e naturale-suono per chat e voce, assicurando coerenza con il tono di marca e la progettazione di conversazione migliori pratiche
• mantenere la documentazione di progettazione di conversazioni pulite, modulari e scalabili per i nostri prodotti
• creare, documentare e valutare la guida a livello di sistema per i personaggi AI e i modelli di interazione
• definire e strutturare gli intenti degli utenti, gli obiettivi e i risultati di conversazione per supportare sia le esperienze di conversazione deterministiche che assistite dall'IA
• progettazione e raffinatezza dei suggerimenti e dei modelli di interazione per sistemi basati su LLM, garantendo uscite sicure, accurate e on-brand
• analizzare le interazioni degli utenti e i registri delle conversazioni, inclusi i KPI come il successo dell'intento, il tasso di risoluzione e la soddisfazione dell'utente, per identificare le aree per il miglioramento e ottimizzare i flussi di conversazione
• assicurarsi che le esperienze di conversazione siano conformi ai requisiti normativi, legali e di privacy dei dati in un ambiente bancario
• tenere aggiornato con le ultime tendenze e le migliori pratiche in AI conversazione, LLM e l'esperienza utente per informare il design di conversazione
• guidare e crescere una comunità intorno alla progettazione di conversazione all'interno dell'organizzazione globale
• agire come leader di pensiero promuovendo pratiche bancarie di conversazione, educare gli stakeholder, e stabilire standard di progettazione di conversazioni in tutta l'organizzazione

Il tuo ritorno di carriera
Siamo aperti alle applicazioni da parte dei ritorni di carriera. Maggiori informazioni sul nostro programma su ubs.com/careercomeback .

La squadra
Marketing, Design & Digital Sales sono costantemente alla ricerca di nuovi talenti per modellare il futuro di UBS. Si lavorerà nel Centro di Eccellenza (CoE) per il Design Esperienza, con sede a Zurigo. Nella nostra organizzazione agile, sarete collaborando con team di progettazione, prodotto, canale, marketing, legale e clienti e sostenere la trasformazione organizzativa verso un'organizzazione di progettazione centrica cliente e modellare le esperienze del cliente mentre si lavora agile in un modello di lavoro ibrido presso gli uffici UBS e da casa.

Le tue abilità ed esperienza
• comprovata esperienza nella progettazione di interfacce di conversazione per chatbot, assistenti vocali, risposte vocali interattive (IVR), e relativo lavoro
• forte comprensione dei principi di conversazione/interazione e linguistica (ad esempio, turn-taking, organizzazione di sequenza, riparazione)
• forte comprensione del trattamento del linguaggio naturale (NLP), della comprensione del linguaggio naturale (NLU) e della sua evoluzione con LLM e quadri agentici
• comprensione di intenti, entità, obiettivi di conversazione, e come supportano chatbot efficace e progettazione assistente virtuale
• lavoro confortevole in spazi di progettazione AI ambigui ed evoluti, dove le migliori pratiche stanno ancora emergendo
• capacità di creare esperienze di conversazione coinvolgenti e naturali che deliziano gli utenti
• competenze analitiche forti per interpretare i dati e prendere decisioni di progettazione informate
• eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali, con la capacità di articolare concetti di progettazione e razionalità chiaramente
• familiarità con LLM e le loro applicazioni pratiche nella progettazione di conversazione
• competenza in Figma e altri strumenti di progettazione avanzati
• è richiesta la competenza in inglese; la competenza in due o più lingue nazionali (tedesco, francese, italiano) è un forte vantaggio
• Istruzione: Corso di laurea in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Linguistica, Scienza informatica, o un campo relativo. L'esperienza rilevante può essere considerata al posto di una laurea

Informazioni su di noi
UBS è un leader e veramente globale gestore di ricchezza e la principale banca universale in Svizzera. Forniamo anche soluzioni di asset management diversificate e capacità di investment banking focalizzate. Con sede a Zurigo, Svizzera, UBS è presente in oltre 50 mercati in tutto il mondo.
Sappiamo che il grande lavoro non è mai fatto da solo. Ecco perché mettiamo la collaborazione al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché insieme, siamo più di noi stessi. Vuoi saperne di più? Visitate ubs.com/careers .

Iscriviti a noi
A UBS, sappiamo che è la nostra gente, con le loro diverse competenze, esperienze e sfondi, che guidano il nostro continuo successo. Siamo dedicati al nostro mestiere e appassionati di mettere al primo posto la nostra gente, con nuove sfide, un team di supporto, opportunità di crescere e opzioni di lavoro flessibili quando possibile. La nostra cultura inclusiva fa emergere il meglio dei nostri dipendenti, ovunque si trovino nel loro viaggio di carriera. E usiamo l'intelligenza artificiale (AI) per lavorare più intelligente ed efficiente. Riconosciamo anche che il grande lavoro non è mai fatto da solo. Ecco perché la collaborazione è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Perché insieme, siamo più di noi stessi.
Ci impegniamo per l'inclusione in disabilità e se avete bisogno di un alloggio ragionevole / adattamenti durante il nostro processo di reclutamento, potete sempre contattarci.

Dettagli di contatto
UBS Business Solutions SA
UBS Reclutamento

Disclaimer / Norme
UBS è un dipendente di pari opportunità. Rispettiamo e cerchiamo di potenziare ogni individuo e di sostenere le diverse culture, prospettive, competenze ed esperienze all'interno della nostra forza lavoro.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Hauptzuständigkeiten
Als Senior Conversation Designer im Experience Design Center of Excellence spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft der Mensch-Computer-Interaktion bei UBS. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Gestaltung und Optimierung von Konversationserlebnissen über eine Reihe von Schnittstellen hinweg, einschließlich Chatbots, Sprachassistenten und aufkommenden KI-gestützten Plattformen. Ihre Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss darauf, wie Benutzer mit unseren Produkten und Dienstleistungen interagieren – und stellt sicher, dass Interaktionen nahtlos, intuitiv und menschenzentriert sind.
Über die Bereitstellung hinaus tragen Sie dazu bei, das Konversationsbanking bei UBS voranzutreiben, indem Sie die Vordenkerführung vorantreiben, Standards gestalten und Stakeholder zu Best Practices im Gesprächsdesign und KI-gestützten Interaktionen aufklären.

Da Konversationserfahrungen zunehmend generative KI und agentische Fähigkeiten beinhalten, besteht die Rolle auch darin, zu untersuchen, wie Aufforderungen, Absichten, Werkzeuge und Systemverhalten so gestaltet werden können, dass sie zuverlässige, hilfreiche und kontextbewusste Benutzerinteraktionen unterstützen. Der ideale Kandidat muss kein technischer Experte für LLMs oder Agentensysteme sein, sondern sollte neugierig, pragmatisch und in der Lage sein, einen starken gesunden Menschenverstand bei der Gestaltung von KI-basierten Erfahrungen anzuwenden.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Design und Optimierung von End-to-End-Gesprächsreisen, von der Entdeckung bis zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, über text- und sprachbasierte Schnittstellen hinweg
• entwickeln und verfeinern Sie Konversationsflüsse und Skripte, einschließlich Fehlerbehandlung, Fallback-Strategien und menschliche Übergabewege, um sicherzustellen, dass sie intuitiv, ansprechend und effektiv sind
• Führen Sie Benutzerrecherchen durch und sammeln Sie Feedback, um die Bedürfnisse, Präferenzen und Schmerzpunkte der Benutzer zu verstehen. Verwenden Sie diese Erkenntnisse, um unser mentales Modell für die Interaktion mit der Bank über eine Konversationsschnittstelle zu skizzieren
• eng mit Produktmanagern, UX-Designern, Entwicklern und anderen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, um Konversationsdesigns an den allgemeinen Produktzielen und User-Experience-Strategien auszurichten
• Schreiben sie einen klaren, prägnanten und natürlich klingenden dialog für chat und stimme, um die konsistenz mit markenton und konversationsdesign best practices zu gewährleisten.
• Pflegen Sie eine saubere, modulare und skalierbare Gesprächsgestaltungsdokumentation für unsere Produkte
• Erstellen, Dokumentieren und Bewerten von System-Level-Guidelines für KI-Personas und Interaktionsmodelle
• Definieren und strukturieren Sie Benutzerabsichten, Ziele und Konversationsergebnisse, um sowohl deterministische als auch KI-gestützte Konversationserfahrungen zu unterstützen
• Design und Verfeinerung von Eingabeaufforderungen und Interaktionsmustern für LLM-basierte Systeme, um sichere, genaue und markeninterne Ausgaben zu gewährleisten
• Analyse von Benutzerinteraktionen und Gesprächsprotokollen, einschließlich KPIs wie Absichtserfolg, Auflösungsrate und Benutzerzufriedenheit, um Verbesserungsbereiche zu identifizieren und den Gesprächsfluss zu optimieren
• sicherzustellen, dass die Konversationserfahrungen den regulatorischen, rechtlichen und datenschutzrechtlichen Anforderungen in einem Bankenumfeld entsprechen
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über die neuesten Trends und Best Practices in der Konversations-KI, LLMs und Benutzererfahrung, um das Gesprächsdesign zu informieren
• Führen und wachsen Sie eine Community rund um Conversation Design innerhalb der globalen Organisation
• Handeln Sie als Vordenker, indem Sie die Praktiken des Konversationsbankings vorantreiben, Stakeholder ausbilden und Konversationsdesign-Standards im gesamten Unternehmen festlegen

Dein Karriere-Comeback
Wir sind offen für Bewerbungen von Career Returnern. Erfahren Sie mehr über unser Programm auf ubs.com/careercomeback.

Das Team
Marketing, Design & Digital Sales sind ständig auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, um die Zukunft von UBS zu gestalten. Sie arbeiten im Center of Excellence (CoE) for Experience Design mit Sitz in Zürich. In unserer agilen Organisation arbeiten Sie mit Design-, Produkt-, Channel-, Marketing-, Rechts- und Kundenbedarfsteams zusammen und unterstützen die organisatorische Transformation hin zu einer kundenzentrierten Designorganisation und gestalten Kundenerfahrungen, während Sie in UBS-Büros und von zu Hause aus agil in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell arbeiten.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Konversationsschnittstellen für Chatbots, Sprachassistenten, interaktive Sprachreaktionen (IVRs) und verwandte Arbeiten
• starkes Verständnis von Gesprächs- / Interaktionsprinzipien und Linguistik (z. B. Wende, Sequenzorganisation, Reparatur)
• Ein starkes Verständnis von Natural Language Processing (NLP), Natural Language Understanding (NLU) Design und seiner Entwicklung mit LLMs und Agentic Frameworks
• Verständnis von Absichten, Entitäten, Konversationszielen und wie sie ein effektives Chatbot- und virtuelles Assistentendesign unterstützen
• komfortables Arbeiten in mehrdeutigen und sich entwickelnden KI-Designräumen, in denen sich Best Practices noch entwickeln
• Fähigkeit, ansprechende und natürliche Konversationserlebnisse zu schaffen, die die Benutzer begeistern
• starke analytische Fähigkeiten, um Daten zu interpretieren und fundierte Designentscheidungen zu treffen
• ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, Designkonzepte und Gründe klar zu artikulieren
• Vertrautheit mit LLMs und ihren praktischen Anwendungen im Gesprächsdesign
• Kenntnisse in Figma und anderen fortgeschrittenen Design-Tools
• Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Kenntnisse in zwei oder mehr Landessprachen (Deutsch, Französisch, Italienisch) sind ein großer Vorteil
• Ausbildung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Design, Mensch-Computer-Interaktion, Linguistik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich. Relevante Erfahrung kann anstelle eines Grades betrachtet werden

UBS ist ein weltweit führender Vermögensverwalter und die führende Universalbank der Schweiz. Wir bieten auch diversifizierte Asset-Management-Lösungen und fokussierte Investment-Banking-Funktionen. Mit Hauptsitz in Zürich, Schweiz, ist UBS in mehr als 50 Märkten auf der ganzen Welt präsent.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Principales responsabilités
En tant que Senior Conversation Designer dans le Experience Design Center of Excellence, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'avenir de l'interaction homme-ordinateur chez UBS. Vous serez responsable de la conception et de l'optimisation d'expériences conversationnelles sur une gamme d'interfaces, y compris les chatbots, les assistants vocaux et les plateformes émergentes pilotées par l'IA. Votre travail influera directement sur la façon dont les utilisateurs s'engagent avec nos produits et services – assurer des interactions sans faille, intuitives et centrées sur l'homme.
Au-delà de la prestation, vous contribuerez à faire progresser les services bancaires de conversation chez UBS en dirigeant la pensée, en formant des normes et en éduquant les intervenants sur les meilleures pratiques en matière de conception de conversation et d'interactions avec l'IA.

Comme les expériences conversationnelles intègrent de plus en plus l'IA générative et les capacités agentsiques, le rôle consiste également à explorer comment les prompts, les intentions, les outils et les comportements du système peuvent être conçus pour soutenir des interactions utilisateur fiables, utiles et contextuelles. Le candidat idéal n'a pas besoin d'être un expert technique dans les LLM ou les systèmes d'agents, mais devrait être curieux, pragmatique et capable d'appliquer le sens commun fort lors de la formation d'expériences alimentées par l'IA.

Vos responsabilités :

• concevoir et optimiser les trajets conversationnels de bout en bout, de la découverte à l'amélioration continue, à travers les interfaces texte et vocale
• développer et affiner les flux et les scripts conversationnels, y compris la gestion des erreurs, les stratégies de repli et les chemins de transfert humains, pour s'assurer qu'ils sont intuitifs, engageants et efficaces;
• effectuer des recherches auprès des utilisateurs et recueillir des commentaires pour comprendre les besoins, les préférences et les points de douleur des utilisateurs. Utilisez ces idées pour décrire le modèle mental de nos utilisateurs lorsqu'ils s'engagent avec la banque à travers une interface conversationnelle
• travailler en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de produits, les concepteurs d'UX, les développeurs et d'autres intervenants pour aligner les conceptions de conversation sur les objectifs globaux du produit et les stratégies d'expérience utilisateur
• rédiger un dialogue clair, concis et naturel pour le chat et la voix, en assurant la cohérence avec les meilleures pratiques de conception de la marque et de la conversation
• maintenir une documentation de conception de conversation propre, modulaire et évolutive pour nos produits
• créer, documenter et évaluer des orientations au niveau du système pour les personas d'IA et les modèles d'interaction;
• définir et structurer les intentions, les buts et les résultats de la conversation des utilisateurs afin de soutenir les expériences de conversation déterministe et assistée par l'IA
• concevoir et affiner les modèles d'impulsions et d'interaction pour les systèmes basés sur la LLM, en assurant des sorties sûres, précises et sur la marque
• analyser les interactions avec les utilisateurs et les journaux de conversation, y compris les ICR comme le succès de l'intention, le taux de résolution et la satisfaction des utilisateurs, afin de cerner les domaines à améliorer et d'optimiser les flux de conversation;
• s'assurer que les expériences de conversation respectent les exigences réglementaires, juridiques et de confidentialité des données dans un environnement bancaire
• tenir à jour les dernières tendances et les meilleures pratiques en matière d'IA conversationnelle, de LLM et d'expérience utilisateur pour éclairer la conception de la conversation
• diriger et développer une communauté autour de la conception de la conversation au sein de l'organisation mondiale
• agir à titre de leader de la pensée en faisant progresser les pratiques bancaires de conversation, en éduquant les intervenants et en établissant des normes de conception de conversation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation

Votre retour professionnel
Nous sommes ouverts aux demandes de retour de carrière. En savoir plus sur notre programme sur ubs.com/careercomeback .

L'équipe
Marketing, design et ventes numériques sont constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents pour façonner l'avenir de UBS. Vous travaillerez au Centre d'Excellence (CoE) pour Experience Design, basé à Zurich. Dans notre organisation agile, vous collaborerez avec des équipes de conception, de produit, de canal, de marketing, de juridique et de client et vous accompagnerez la transformation organisationnelle vers une organisation de conception centrée sur le client et vous façonnerez les expériences client tout en travaillant agile dans un modèle de travail hybride dans les bureaux d'UBS et de chez vous.

Vos compétences et votre expérience
• Expérience éprouvée dans la conception d'interfaces conversationnelles pour les chatbots, les assistants vocaux, les réponses vocales interactives (RIV) et les travaux connexes
• bonne compréhension des principes de conversation et d'interaction et de la linguistique (p. ex., prise de tour, organisation de séquence, réparation)
• une bonne compréhension du traitement du langage naturel (NLP), de la conception du langage naturel (NLU) et de son évolution avec les LLM et les cadres agentsiques
• compréhension des intentions, des entités, des objectifs de conversation et de la façon dont ils soutiennent le chatbot efficace et la conception d'assistant virtuel
• travail confortable dans des espaces de conception de l'IA ambigus et évolutifs, où les meilleures pratiques sont toujours en train de se développer
• capacité à créer des expériences conversationnelles passionnantes et naturelles qui ravissent les utilisateurs
• compétences analytiques solides pour interpréter les données et prendre des décisions de conception éclairées
• excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, avec la capacité d'articuler clairement les concepts de conception et la justification
• Connaissance des LLM et de leurs applications pratiques dans la conception des conversations
• compétence en Figma et autres outils de conception avancés
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est nécessaire; la maîtrise de deux langues nationales ou plus (allemand, français, italien) est un avantage important
• Études: Baccalauréat en design, interaction homme-ordinateur, linguistique, informatique, ou un domaine connexe. L'expérience pertinente peut être considérée au lieu d'un diplôme

À propos de nous
UBS est un chef de file en matière de gestion de patrimoine mondial et la première banque universelle en Suisse. Nous fournissons également des solutions diversifiées de gestion d'actifs et des capacités de banque d'investissement ciblées. Rejoignez-nous
Chez UBS, nous savons que ce sont nos employés, avec leurs compétences, leurs expériences et leurs antécédents divers, qui sont à l'origine de notre succès continu. Nous sommes dévoués à notre métier et passionnés de mettre nos gens en premier, avec de nouveaux défis, une équipe de soutien, des opportunités de croissance et des options de travail flexibles si possible. Notre culture inclusive fait ressortir le meilleur de nos employés, où qu'ils soient sur leur parcours de carrière. Key responsibilities
• technical analysis of business requirements from various stakeholders and implementation of the requirements in a comprehensive and modern IT environment
• preparation of impact analyses and estimates for various projects
• acting as Subject Matter Expert in the area of Core Card Management for internal and cross-application projects
• building up knowledge of the existing application landscape and using this knowledge for extensions of the applications
• providing 3rd level support for the Core Card Management area, further support tasks including on-call duty

The team
In our agile Client & Card Management team, you are on the move with enthusiasm as an experienced COBOL developer on the mainframe. You develop and improve robust and scalable components for our core card applications with ease. As a second competence, you have acquired broad knowledge of Linux systems.
You are responsible for the further development and maintenance of the core of our application landscape and possess knowledge of the most important business processes in card processing.

Your skills and experience
• excellent knowledge of the CMM products ACI-Issuer and ACI-Interchange
• excellent knowledge in programming with COBOL, DB2 (SQL)
• very good experience with ChangeMan, UrbanCodeDeployment
• very good knowledge of JCL, Control-M and CICS, VSAM, z/OS
• very good user knowledge of Confluence Jira
• expertise in the application of PCI DSS 4.0 standards
• good knowledge of Java / Spring boot / Maven / Jenkins / Git
• good analytical skills; you know how to approach and solve problems
• enjoy independent, proactive work in an agile, motivated and highly competent crew
• experience in an agile environment, for example as ScrumMaster
• experience in the financial sector, especially in the card business, is of inestimable advantage
• language skills in spoken and written English (at least C1) and German (at least B1)

About us
UBS Card Center AG with its headquarters in Glattbrugg and an additional office in Manno TI is part of UBS Switzerland AG and employs over 750 people. As the leading credit card processor in Switzerland, we process over 3 million Visa and Mastercard credit cards. In doing so, we stand close by our customers' side - with experience, commitment and vision.

Join us
At UBS Card Center we embrace flexible working arrangements and offer different working models such as part-time, job-sharing and hybrid working. Our purpose-driven culture and global infrastructure help us connect and collaborate in agile ways to meet all our business needs. A working environment driven by innovation, digitalization, new mobile payment methods and customer experience awaits you.

• fornire il supporto di terzo livello per l'area di Core Card Management, ulteriori compiti di supporto, tra cui il dovere di chiamata

La squadra
Nel nostro team di gestione clienti e carte agili, sei in movimento con entusiasmo come sviluppatore COBOL esperto nel mainframe. Sviluppa e migliora componenti robusti e scalabili per le nostre applicazioni di schede di base con facilità. Come seconda competenza, hai acquisito una vasta conoscenza dei sistemi Linux.
Lei è responsabile per l'ulteriore sviluppo e la manutenzione del nucleo del nostro paesaggio di applicazione e possiede la conoscenza dei processi aziendali più importanti nel trattamento delle carte.

Le tue abilità ed esperienza
• ottima conoscenza dei prodotti CMM ACI-Issuer e ACI-Interchange
• conoscenza eccellente nella programmazione con COBOL, DB2 (SQL)
• molto buona esperienza con ChangeMan, UrbanCodeDeployment
• conoscenza molto buona di JCL, Control-M e CICS, VSAM, z/OS
• conoscenza utente molto buona di Confluence Jira
• esperienza nell'applicazione degli standard PCI DSS 4.0
• buona conoscenza di Java / Spring boot / Maven / Jenkins / Git
• buone capacità analitiche; sai come affrontare e risolvere i problemi
• godere di lavoro indipendente, proattivo in un equipaggio agile, motivato e altamente competente
• esperienza in un ambiente agile, ad esempio come ScrumMaster
• esperienza nel settore finanziario, soprattutto nel settore della carta, è di inestimabile vantaggio
• competenze linguistiche in inglese parlato e scritto (almeno C1) e tedesco (almeno B1)

Su di noi
UBS Card Center AG con sede a Glattbrugg e un ufficio aggiuntivo a Manno TI fa parte della UBS Svizzera AG e impiega oltre 750 persone. Come principale processore di carta di credito in Svizzera, elaboriamo oltre 3 milioni di carte di credito Visa e Mastercard. In questo modo, siamo vicini dal lato dei nostri clienti - con esperienza, impegno e visione.

Iscriviti a noi
Al UBS Card Center abbracciamo accordi di lavoro flessibili e offriamo diversi modelli di lavoro come part-time, job-sharing e lavoro ibrido. La nostra cultura mirata e l'infrastruttura globale ci aiutano a collegare e collaborare in modi agili per soddisfare tutte le nostre esigenze aziendali. Un ambiente di lavoro guidato da innovazione, digitalizzazione, nuovi metodi di pagamento mobile e esperienza del cliente vi aspetta.

• preparation of impact analyses and estimates for various projects
• acting as Subject Matter Expert in the area of Core Card Management for internal and cross-application projects
• building up knowledge of the existing application landscape and using this knowledge for extensions of the applications
• providing 3rd level support for the Core Card Management area, further support tasks including on-call duty

The team
In our agile Client & Card Management team, you are on the move with enthusiasm as an experienced COBOL developer on the mainframe. You develop and improve robust and scalable components for our core card applications with ease. As a second competence, you have acquired broad knowledge of Linux systems.
You are responsible for the further development and maintenance of the core of our application landscape and possess knowledge of the most important business processes in card processing.

Your skills and experience
• excellent knowledge of the CMM products ACI-Issuer and ACI-Interchange
• excellent knowledge in programming with COBOL, DB2 (SQL)
• very good experience with ChangeMan, UrbanCodeDeployment
• very good knowledge of JCL, Control-M and CICS, VSAM, z/OS
• very good user knowledge of Confluence Jira
• expertise in the application of PCI DSS 4.0 standards
• good knowledge of Java / Spring boot / Maven / Jenkins / Git
• good analytical skills; you know how to approach and solve problems
• enjoy independent, proactive work in an agile, motivated and highly competent crew
• experience in an agile environment, for example as ScrumMaster
• experience in the financial sector, especially in the card business, is of inestimable advantage
• language skills in spoken and written English (at least C1) and German (at least B1)

About us
UBS Card Center AG with its headquarters in Glattbrugg and an additional office in Manno TI is part of UBS Switzerland AG and employs over 750 people. As the leading credit card processor in Switzerland, we process over 3 million Visa and Mastercard credit cards. In doing so, we stand close by our customers' side - with experience, commitment and vision.

Join us
At UBS Card Center we embrace flexible working arrangements and offer different working models such as part-time, job-sharing and hybrid working. Our purpose-driven culture and global infrastructure help us connect and collaborate in agile ways to meet all our business needs. A working environment driven by innovation, digitalization, new mobile payment methods and customer experience awaits you.

jobs.description:
Key responsibilities
• aktive Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines definierten Firmenkundenportfolios im Bereich Karten‑ und T&E‑Lösungen
• Planung und Durchführung von Kundenbesuchen, Beratungsgesprächen und Reviews (on‑/off‑site und remote)
• Analyse von Kundenbedürfnissen, Spesen‑ und Reiseprozessen sowie Karten‑Nutzungsdaten zur Identifikation von Potenzialen
• Beratung zu Firmenkarten‑, T&E‑ und Zusatzlösungen (z.B. virtuelle Karten, zentrale Abrechnung, Reporting)
Nutzung von CRM‑, Reporting‑ und Analytics‑Tools, um Sales‑Opportunitäten zu erkennen und gezielt zu bearbeiten
• Koordination von Implementierungen, Programm‑Setups, Limit‑Anpassungen und Servicefällen mit internen Stellen
• aktive Förderung der Nutzung von digitalen Karten‑ und T&E‑Tools (Portale, Apps, Self‑Service)
• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von KYC‑, Risiko‑, Compliance‑ und kartenspezifischen Richtlinien
• Dokumentation von Kundeninteraktionen, Opportunities und Abschlüssen in den relevanten Systemen
• Einbringen von Markt‑ und Kundenfeedback zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Karten‑ und T&E‑Angebots

The team
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Sales Commercial Cards & Travel & Expense (T&E) suchen wir eine vertriebsstarke, pragmatische und kundenorientierte Persönlichkeit mit fundierter Erfahrung im Banking oder Bankenumfeld. In dieser Rolle betreust du ein definiertes Firmenkundenportfolio im Raum Zürich, entwickelst Karten‑ und T&E‑Programme weiter und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zu Wachstum, Effizienz und Kundenzufriedenheit.

Wenn du Freude an B2B‑Vertrieb, datenbasierter Beratung und modernen Karten‑/T&E‑Lösungen hast, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Your skills and experience
• 3–5 Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Karten‑, T&E‑ oder Corporate‑Banking‑Vertrieb mit nachweisbarer Sales‑ und Beratungserfahrung
• bevorzugt Berufserfahrung im Banking oder Bankenumfeld
• ausgeprägte Verkaufs‑ und Beratungskompetenz im B2B‑Umfeld sowie Freude an der Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
• fundiertes Verständnis von Firmenkarten‑, T&E‑ und Abrechnungslösungen oder die Bereitschaft, sich rasch und vertieft einzuarbeiten
• starke analytische Fähigkeiten und sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen (Volumen, Nutzung, Ertrag, Reisespendaten)
• strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
• hohe Integrität, Risikobewusstsein und Compliance‑Orientierung
• hohe Belastbarkeit und Leistungsbereitschaft mit einem guten Prozessverständnis
• sehr gute Kommunikations‑ und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. C1); weitere Sprachen von Vorteil
• hohe Affinität zu digitalen Tools (MS Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel; idealerweise CRM‑ und Fachsysteme)

About us
Die UBS Card Center AG, eine Tochtergesellschaft der UBS Switzerland AG, ist der führende Kreditkartenprozessor der Schweiz. Weit über 3 Millionen Kreditkarten von Visa und Mastercard werden zuverlässig über unsere Systeme abgewickelt. Mit mehr als 750 engagierten Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Glattbrugg und Manno verbinden wir langjährige Expertise mit Innovationskraft und arbeiten täglich daran, den Zahlungsverkehr von morgen einfacher, sicherer und smarter zu machen.

How we hire
Es kann sein, dass wir Sie dazu auffordern, während des Bewerbungsprozesses ein oder mehrere Einstufungstests durchzuführen. Erfahren Sie mehr darüber (EN)

Join us
Bei UBS wissen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden mit ihren unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Hintergründen unseren Erfolg ausmachen. Wir setzen uns leidenschaftlich dafür ein, unsere Mitarbeitenden an die erste Stelle zu setzen, indem wir ihnen neue Herausforderungen, ein unterstützendes Team, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und, wenn möglich, flexible Arbeitsbedingungen bieten. Unsere integrative Kultur bringt das Beste aus unseren Mitarbeitenden heraus, egal wo sie sich auf ihrem Karriereweg befinden. Und wir nutzen künstliche Intelligenz (KI), um intelligenter und effizienter zu arbeiten. Wir wissen auch, dass grossartige Arbeit nie allein geleistet wird. Deshalb steht die Zusammenarbeit im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Denn zusammen sind wir stärker.

descriptionByLocale.it:

- supporto attivo e sviluppo di un portafoglio aziendale definito nel campo delle soluzioni per carte e T&E - pianificazione ed esecuzione di visite, consultazioni e revisioni dei clienti (in loco/off-site e remoto) - analisi delle esigenze dei clienti, delle spese e dei processi di viaggio, nonché dati sull'utilizzo delle carte per identificare potenziali - consulenza sulle carte aziendali, T&E e soluzioni aggiuntive (ad esempio.

mappe virtuali, fatturazione centrale, reporting) - utilizzo di strumenti CRM, reporting e analisi per individuare e indirizzare le opportunità di vendita - coordinamento delle implementazioni, setup dei programmi, aggiustamenti dei limiti e casi di servizio con organismi interni - promozione attiva dell'uso di strumenti T&E e T&E (porti, app, self-service) - garanzia di conformità con KYC, rischi, conformità e linee guida specifiche per le carte - documentazione delle interazioni con i clienti, jossa e bilanci nei sistemi pertinenti - bilancio di mercato e finanziario

Opinioni dei clienti sull'ulteriore sviluppo delle nostre offerte di carta e T&E
descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks

- active support and development of a defined corporate portfolio in the field of card and T&E solutions - planning and execution of customer visits, consultation and reviews (on-/off-site and remote) - analysis of customer needs, expenses and travel processes, and card usage data for identifying potentials - consulting on company cards, T&E and additional solutions (e.g.

virtual maps, central billing, reporting) - use of CRM, reporting and analytics tools to identify and target sales opportunities - coordination of implementations, program setups, limit adjustments and service cases with internal bodies - active promotion of the use of digital card and T&E tools (portals, apps, self-service) - ensuring compliance with KYC, risk, compliance and card-specific guidelines - documentation of customer interactions, joss and financial statements in relevant systems - market and financial statements

Customer feedback on the further development of our card and T&E offerings

jobs.description:
Key responsibilities
• lead the architecture, engineering and continuous optimization of our diverse HSM landscape, ensuring full adherence to security and compliance standards
• automate the HSM environment and optimize configurations and related processes to meet demanding SLAs
• monitor current trends and technologies in the HSM space and evaluate their potential and applicability for our organization
• drive the further development of the HSM environment and design solutions in close collaboration with application projects
• analyze issues, resolve incidents and optimize performance in close cooperation with infrastructure and application teams
• participate in an on-call rotation for technical incidents and access to key material as part of a four-person HSM support team
• take on selected network-related tasks to support colleagues in the areas of firewall, load balancing and switching/routing, with the opportunity to further develop your skills within a team of network specialists

The team
To strengthen our IT Platform Services department, we are looking for an experienced, service-oriented HSM Engineer (f/m/d) with project management experience. We offer a dynamic and exciting environment where you can actively contribute, as well as a highly motivated team and a collaborative working atmosphere.

Your skills and experience
• university degree or equivalent education in computer science or a related field
• several years of experience in designing and managing complex projects
• solid technical experience with the following products: Thales Luna, Payshield 10k, KeySecure/CTM, ProtectServer 2/3, Azure Key Vault
• willingness to continue learning and to take on challenges in a demanding IT environment
• experience with network technologies such as firewalls (Fortigate), load balancing (F5) and switching/routing (Cisco/Arista) is an advantage
• experience as a Product Owner or in requirements management, ideally with knowledge of agile methods (e.g. Scrum, SAFe), is a plus
• strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset and excellent communication abilities
• business-fluent German and English skills

About us
UBS Card Center AG with its headquarters in Glattbrugg and an additional office in Manno TI is part of UBS Switzerland AG and employs over 750 people. As the leading credit card processor in Switzerland, we process over 3 million Visa and Mastercard credit cards. In doing so, we stand close by our customers' side - with experience, commitment and vision.

Join us
At UBS Card Center we embrace flexible working arrangements and offer different working models such as part-time, job-sharing and hybrid working. Our purpose-driven culture and global infrastructure help us connect and collaborate in agile ways to meet all our business needs. A working environment driven by innovation, digitalization, new mobile payment methods and customer experience awaits you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione - guidare l'architettura, l'ingegneria e l'ottimizzazione continua del nostro paesaggio HSM, garantendo la piena aderenza agli standard di sicurezza e conformità - automatizzare l'ambiente HSM e ottimizzare le configurazioni e i processi correlati per soddisfare gli SLA esigenti - monitorare le tendenze e le tecnologie attuali nello spazio HSM e valutarne il potenziale e l'applicabilità per la nostra organizzazione - guidare l'ulteriore sviluppo dell'ambiente HSM e soluzioni di progettazione in stretta collaborazione con progetti applicativi - analizzare problemi, risolvere incidenti e ottimizzare le prestazioni in un ambiente chiuso

cooperazione con le squadre di infrastruttura e di applicazione - partecipare a una rotazione di chiamata per incidenti tecnici e l'accesso a materiale chiave come parte di un team di supporto HSM quattro persone - assumere compiti specifici relativi alla rete per sostenere i colleghi in settori di firewall, bilanciamento del carico e commutazione/rotta, con la possibilità di sviluppare ulteriormente le vostre competenze all'interno di un team di specialisti della rete
descriptionByLocale.en:
Key responsibilities
• lead the architecture, engineering and continuous optimization of our diverse HSM landscape, ensuring full adherence to security and compliance standards
• automate the HSM environment and optimize configurations and related processes to meet demanding SLAs
• monitor current trends and technologies in the HSM space and evaluate their potential and applicability for our organization
• drive the further development of the HSM environment and design solutions in close collaboration with application projects
• analyze issues, resolve incidents and optimize performance in close cooperation with infrastructure and application teams
• participate in an on-call rotation for technical incidents and access to key material as part of a four-person HSM support team
• take on selected network-related tasks to support colleagues in the areas of firewall, load balancing and switching/routing, with the opportunity to further develop your skills within a team of network specialists

The team
To strengthen our IT Platform Services department, we are looking for an experienced, service-oriented HSM Engineer (f/m/d) with project management experience. We offer a dynamic and exciting environment where you can actively contribute, as well as a highly motivated team and a collaborative working atmosphere.

Your skills and experience
• university degree or equivalent education in computer science or a related field
• several years of experience in designing and managing complex projects
• solid technical experience with the following products: Thales Luna, Payshield 10k, KeySecure/CTM, ProtectServer 2/3, Azure Key Vault
• willingness to continue learning and to take on challenges in a demanding IT environment
• experience with network technologies such as firewalls (Fortigate), load balancing (F5) and switching/routing (Cisco/Arista) is an advantage
• experience as a Product Owner or in requirements management, ideally with knowledge of agile methods (e.g. Scrum, SAFe), is a plus
• strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset and excellent communication abilities
• business-fluent German and English skills

About us
UBS Card Center AG with its headquarters in Glattbrugg and an additional office in Manno TI is part of UBS Switzerland AG and employs over 750 people. As the leading credit card processor in Switzerland, we process over 3 million Visa and Mastercard credit cards. In doing so, we stand close by our customers' side - with experience, commitment and vision.

Join us
At UBS Card Center we embrace flexible working arrangements and offer different working models such as part-time, job-sharing and hybrid working. Our purpose-driven culture and global infrastructure help us connect and collaborate in agile ways to meet all our business needs. A working environment driven by innovation, digitalization, new mobile payment methods and customer experience awaits you.

Zusammenarbeit mit Infrastruktur- und Anwendungsteams - Teilnahme an einer Bereitschaftsrotation für technische Vorfälle und Zugang zu Schlüsselmaterial im Rahmen eines vierköpfigen HSM-Supportteams - Übernahme ausgewählter netzwerkbezogener
• Aufgaben zur Unterstützung von Kollegen in den Bereichen Firewall, Lastausgleich und Umschaltung/Routing, mit der Möglichkeit, Ihre Kompetenzen innerhalb eines Netzwerk-Spezialistenteams weiterzuentwickeln

coopération avec les équipes d'infrastructure et d'application - participer à une rotation sur appel pour les incidents techniques et l'accès aux matériaux clés dans le cadre d'une équipe de soutien HSM de quatre personnes - assumer certaines tâches liées au réseau pour aider les collègues dans les domaines du pare-feu, de l'équilibrage de charge et de la commutation/acheminement, avec la possibilité de développer vos compétences au sein d'une équipe de spécialistes du réseau

jobs.description:
Key responsibilities
• Assess SaaS and PaaS services for compliance with internal policies, FINMA, DSG, PCI DSS (cloud), and data sovereignty requirements
• Enhance and manage security tooling (CASB, CSPM, SSPM) for third-party cloud service governance
• Integrate cloud security controls with SOC and Cyber Defense platforms for effective threat detection and response
• Automate security controls, compliance checks, and integrate security into CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code workflows
• Advise and review cloud solution designs for policy compliance; lead security design reviews and sign-offs
• Support onboarding and secure integration of third-party SaaS/PaaS with internal security processes (IAM, key management, secure data exchange)
• Collaborate with risk assessment teams and key stakeholders across IT, business, and vendors

The team
As part of the new "Cloud Center of Excellence" team in the IT department of UBS Card Center AG, you will shape our journey to the cloud by contributing to a strong cloud governance framework together with cloud senior cloud architect and cloud engineers.

Your skills and experience
• Strong experience in risk management, governance frameworks, and Swiss/EU regulatory compliance (FINMA, DSG, PCI DSS)
• Deep knowledge of IT security standards (ISO 27001, CSA-CCM, NIST CSF, COBIT, MITRE)
• Expertise in SaaS, PaaS, and cloud security implications
• Hands-on with CASB, CSPM, SSPM, and integration with SOC/SIEM
• Proven track record in automating security controls and compliance in cloud environments
• Experience with Microsoft Azure and other major cloud platforms
• Skilled in assessing and integrating third-party cloud solutions
• Familiarity with data protection (DSG, GDPR), compliance, and threat modeling
• CCSP or similar cloud security certifications highly desirable

Join us
UBS Card Center AG with its headquarters in Glattbrugg and an additional office in Manno TI is part of UBS Switzerland AG and employs over 750 people. As the leading credit card processor in Switzerland, we process over 3 million Visa and Mastercard credit cards. In doing so, we stand close by our customers' side - with experience, commitment and vision.

Disclaimer / Policy statements
